transported in a removal van and Leigh took them to
customs. The machines came from Mills Novelty Co.
Chicago.

Information re San Francisco.
Wm. or "Bill" Sleat.
Merchant's Inn (Clearing Headquarters)
(Tel: Kearney 167) 144 or 44 California St. San Francisco
is referred to in Cables as "Mr. Short".
The Mr. Long referred to in cables is an officer on USS
Chaumont. Not sure of name.
Informant she was beaten for seeing above names on a
secret file.
Another cable or letter, not sure which, gives telephone
Garfield
San Francisco No. 12351
or 12354
Name said to be
"Milky" or "Mickey" O'Brien, said to be the "perfect killer".

Shanghai Connections.
H.O. Tong has visited 41 Verdun Terrace many times since
19-11-31 and visits were returned to H. home by C. T.B.
Tang formerly kept Jansen Trading Co. Love Lane. Curio
dealing. He gave C 4 pictures and 1 screen, jade inlaid
which are now at 41 Verdun Terrace. They are said to be
priceless. loot from Gen. Wu Pei Foo.
H.O.T. and C had room No.21 St. Eastern Hotel, shared
expenses.
St. Eastern Hotel room is 84 visited by Ip Man and 2 Liang's.
pages.zh:
3

在同一次行程中，C从美国发电报给L.l.，让她从
“肖蒙号”（Chaumont）上取下12台机器。她带着那个男孩
（C的儿子）到河边，让他坐舢板去美国军舰，
他带着装在箱子里的12台机器回来，这些机器
用搬家货车运输，利（Leigh）将它们带到海关。这些机器来自
芝加哥的米尔斯新奇公司（Mills Novelty Co.）。

关于旧金山的情报。
威廉姆或“比尔”·斯利特（Wm. or "Bill" Sleat）。
商人旅馆（清算总部）
（电话：Kearney 167）加利福尼亚街144号或44号，旧金山
在电报中被称为“肖特先生”。
电报中提到的朗先生是美国军舰
肖蒙号上的一名军官。名字不确定。
线人称她因在秘密档案中看到上述名字而遭到殴打。
另一封电报或信件，不确定是哪一种，给出电话
加菲尔德
旧金山号码 12351
或 12354
据说名字是
“米尔基”（Milky）或“米奇”（Mickey）奥布莱恩（O'Brien），据说是“完美杀手”。

上海关系网。
自1931年11月19日以来，H.O. Tong多次访问凡尔登露台41号，
C曾回访H的家。T.B. Tang以前在爱文义路（Love Lane）经营
詹森贸易公司（Jansen Trading Co.），从事古玩交易。他给了C
4幅画和1个嵌玉屏风，现存放于凡尔登露台41号。据说这些
物品价值连城，是吴佩孚将军的赃物。
H.O.T.和C住在东方饭店（St. Eastern Hotel）21号房间，分摊费用。
叶问（Ip Man）和两名梁氏（Liang's）访问过东方饭店84号房间。

pages.en:
4
Opium supply comes from Rue Saigon. L.J.l. knows
the alleyway. C fetches in m/car 6477.

Ah Lee's "plant" socalled corner Alcock and Fongshan
Rd.

Ex U.S. Marine (known as Short) lives with another
man, called by C. a beachcomber, believed to be
deserted Seaman.
May have Japanese wife, as C spoke Japanese over
phone to get him.
(C. speaks Japanese, Russian and Mandarin Chinese)
He meets Short in the Palace Hotel Bar and Cathay Bar.
Short lives in 3rd alleyway past (believed to be:-
Quinsan Rd alleyway runs North) a Tinsmith's shop in
alleyway which is two doors from the house.
Opposite and near "Lion Cafe".

John Scott late Park Pavilion, now Steward on Dollar ?
boat. Heard once mentioned "Madison". Not sure of
boat, only of the man visits C. and receives visits
when in Port.
Rabikoff (now in gaol re buying guns from U.S. marines)
and Cantonese named Ong closely connected with the
firearms business. Both are visitors to 41 Verdun Terrace.

Leigh. Eurasian, speaks English well, tall, wears
eyeglasses and looks like Wm Haines the movie star.
Nationality ? Closely connected with C. Deputised
fixing slot machines when C away.
(C was in U.S.A. Aug. 3 to Oct. 10, 1930)
Leigh's former address, 1284 Rue Lafayette. Has Chinese
wife. Address now? Goes about a lot with S.H. Fan
of 25 Jinkoo Rd, another close connection.
When C was in U.S.A., L.J.l. paid him $500.00 on cabled
pages.zh:
4
鸦片供应来自西贡路（Rue Saigon）。L.J.l.知道
那条小巷。C用汽车6477号运入。

阿李（Ah Lee）的所谓“据点”位于阿尔科克路（Alcock Rd.）和凤山路（Fongshan Rd.）拐角处。

一名前美国海军陆战队员（被称为肖特）与另一名
男子同住，C称其为流浪汉，据信是
被遗弃的水手。
可能有日本妻子，因为C通过电话用日语
联系他。
（C会说日语、俄语和普通话）
他在华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）酒吧和华懋酒吧（Cathay Bar）会见肖特。
肖特住在过去第三条小巷里（据信是：
昆山路（Quinsan Rd.）小巷向北延伸）一家锡匠铺所在的小巷，
距离那所房子两扇门远。
对面靠近“狮子咖啡馆”（Lion Cafe）。

约翰·斯科特（John Scott）原在派克馆（Park Pavilion），现在是美元
轮船上的服务员？曾听到一次提到“麦迪逊”（Madison）。不确定
是哪艘船，只确定此人访问C，并在港口停留时接受访问。
拉比科夫（Rabikoff）（现因从美国海军陆战队购买枪支而入狱）
和一名姓翁（Ong）的广东人与军火生意密切相关。两人都是
凡尔登露台41号的访客。

利（Leigh）。欧亚混血儿，英语流利，身材高大，戴眼镜，
长得像电影明星威廉·海恩斯（Wm Haines）。
国籍？与C关系密切。在C不在时代理修理
老虎机。
（C于1930年8月3日至10月10日在美国）
利以前的地址，拉斐特路1284号。有中国
妻子。现在的地址？经常与金谷路25号的范某（S.H. Fan）
一起外出，这是另一个密切关系人。
当C在美国时，L.J.l.根据C的电报指示付给他500.00美元

pages.en:
5
instructions from C..

One new secretary, Jewish, being 307 Rue Bougeat
has been warned off by informant on Nov. 7th after
starting work with C. (by L.l).

Mrs. J.B. Manly (ex-wife) C assault case.
Now in Hongkong knows much of C business though a
mutual friend. Warned L.J.l. to get out before too
late.
Mrs. J.B.M. knows all about Lincoln car when K.C. was in
Sh. says French Police had full details, but were in
league with him. Told L.l. that U.S. Cons. official
told her about C's opium and morphine trade?

L.l. has been to visit Sih's before on several occasions
at Ferry Rd. and the Sih's have visited 41 Verdun Terrace.
(same people!) Visit on Aug. 4th. Mrs. Sih was taken
ill after eating at C's. C's children too?

Mrs. Fontaine in cooperation with C's when Chaumont
officers ashore.

Wilders.
Ever since arrived stays at 41 Verdun.
C. is going to Tsingtao on Sunday 29-11-31 to take
Annette to Convent. Said to be staying one month.
Wid learning slot business etc. and is taking over
control. His wife expected, and both will take over
41 Verdun Terrace. His sister is at Cathay Mansions.
Constantly visits L.J.l. and begs, pleads, threatens.
She must meet C and talk before Sunday. She will do
so if we wish in any place we say, if protected.
Instructions awaited.
pages.zh:
5

一名新秘书，犹太人，住在布热亚路307号（Rue Bougeat），
在开始为C工作后（由L.l.安排），于11月7日被线人警告离开。

J.B.曼利夫人（前妻）C袭击案。
现在在香港，虽然通过共同朋友，但了解很多C的
业务。警告L.J.l.趁早脱身。
J.B.M.夫人知道KC在上海时的林肯轿车的所有情况，说法国警察掌握全部细节，但与他串通一气。告诉L.l.，美国领事馆官员
告诉她关于C的鸦片和吗啡贸易？

L.l.曾多次前往渡轮路（Ferry Rd.）拜访施家（Sih's），施家也访问过
凡尔登露台41号。（同一群人！）8月4日的访问。施太太在C家
吃饭后生病。C的孩子也是？

方丹夫人（Mrs. Fontaine）在肖蒙号军官上岸期间与C合作。

怀尔德斯（Wilders）。
自从抵达后一直住在凡尔登露台41号。
C将于1931年11月29日星期日前往青岛，送安妮特（Annette）去修道院。据说停留一个月。
威德（Wid）正在学习老虎机业务等，并接管控制权。他的妻子预计到来，两人都将接管
凡尔登露台41号。他的妹妹在国泰公寓（Cathay Mansions）。
不断访问L.J.l.，乞求、恳求、威胁。
她必须在星期日前会见C并谈话。如果我们希望，她可以在我们指定的任何地方这样做，前提是受到保护。
等待指示。

pages.en:
6

Wid asks enlightening questions may be of interest to
us. What does she know about the Nevada affair? What
is threatening C.? but L.J.l. professes no knowledge
in many cases and has told him someone called for her
fingerprints but she refused.

C's son told L.l. he overheard C and W arrange to get
L.l. to door of her home and force her into m/car. Boy
saw both take pistol to visit L.l. but learned by phone
they were not admitted.
Girl Annette is now spying for C.. Searched L.l.'s drawers.
Notes jotted for us of little import have disappeared from
the house. Asked L.l. yesterday to escort her home. Boy
warned of arrangement and that C and W were around the
corner.
A Russian female also sent to trap her.

Wilder wants L.l. to go to Cathay Mansion to sign statement
saying she knows nothing of C's business etc.?
The above named Swiss subject, holder of Swiss passport
No.1099 issued at Mexico City April 15th, 1928, and bearing
a visa for entry into China issued at Geneva on October 8th,
1931, returned to Shanghai on November 14th, 1931. He
travelled from Albirrden, Switzerland, to Italy and embarked
on October 17th, 1931, at Venice as a deck passenger aboard
the Lloyd Triestino Navigation Coy's S.S. "Gange".
Wilder is at present occupying Room No.24 at the Strand
Hotel, 109 Szechuen Road.

When we left at 12 ma. 24-11-31 C. & W. were waiting in
m/car 6477 in an alley nearby, no lights. Don't think
recognised, walked into P. Club. Then out to m.car on
club ranks. C.D.S. as chauffeur. Other watcher too.
Shook off car driving around F'town.
pages.zh:
6

威德提出了一些启发性的问题，可能对我们
感兴趣。她知道内华达事件多少？什么在威胁C？但L.J.l.声称在许多情况下不知情，并告诉他有人索要她的指纹，但她拒绝了。

C的儿子告诉L.l.，他无意中听到C和W安排将
L.l.诱骗到她家门口，强行把她塞进汽车。男孩看到两人带枪去拜访L.l.，但通过电话得知他们未被允许进入。
女孩安妮特现在为C充当间谍。搜查了L.l.的抽屉。
为我们记下的无关紧要的笔记已从家中消失。昨天要求L.l.护送她回家。男孩警告了这一安排，且C和W就在拐角处。
还派了一名俄罗斯女性去陷害她。

怀尔德想让L.l.去国泰公寓签署一份声明，说她对C的业务等一无所知？
上述瑞士籍人士，持有1928年4月15日在墨西哥城签发的瑞士护照第1099号，以及1931年10月8日在日内瓦签发的入境中国签证，于1931年11月14日返回上海。他从瑞士阿尔比尔登（Albirrden）旅行至意大利，并于1931年10月17日在威尼斯作为甲板乘客登上劳埃德·特里斯蒂诺航运公司（Lloyd Triestino Navigation Coy）的“恒河号”（S.S. "Gange"）轮船。
怀尔德目前住在四川北路109号斯特兰德饭店（Strand Hotel）24号房间。

当我们于1931年11月24日中午12点离开时，C和W在附近一条没有灯光的小巷里的汽车6477号中等待。我想没有被认出来，走进了公园总会（P. Club）。然后走到总会出租车候客处的汽车旁。C.D.S.当司机。还有另一名监视者。
在法租界兜圈甩掉了那辆车。

pages.en:
2

L.l. Thinks she could decode the message through
knowledge of the old code if necessary.

USS Chaumont.

Confederates: J.P. Wilson about 45 years of age
"Red" MacHenry about 32 years of age.

Wilson often visited the old O'well Rd. appartment in 1930.
McHenry came later.

C sold McHenry of diamond rings obtained in his mortgage
business.

Both visited 41 Verdun Terrace, the last time being about
Aug. 8 - 14th? Also the Pavilion Blen.

Wilson bragged that if this deal came off he would
retire and return to U.S. as a passenger. On the same
occasion, C was so friendly that he made L.J.l. take off
her own emerald and diamond ring and give it to McHenry
with whom he was very "close".

When C and L.l. saw them on board, (one day in August)
with the package, Mrs. Lucy Fontaine accompanied them.

Since marital troubles Mrs. F. has tried to persuade Lol.
to give the child Annette to her to be adopted by McH?
Tried very hard? She also told L.l. that her time with
C was nearly finished.

Last Aug. Sept. Told her write McH to send 3-4 slot
machines to earn living.

Did so, explaining marital discord.

Major Holcomb knows. He was told because there may be
some implication.

L.J.l. told by M that Wilson and McHenry had been
arrested.

Wilson visited L.J.l. in C's absence in U.S.A.. L.J.l.
refused dealings, being afraid of his sexual importunities.
C raved on his return. He had arranged for W to go with
L.l. to Qns to get consignment of tins.
pages.zh:
2

L.l.认为如果有必要，她可以通过旧密码的知识来解码信息。

美国军舰肖蒙号（USS Chaumont）。

同伙：J.P.威尔逊（Wilson），约45岁
“红发”麦克亨利（MacHenry），约32岁。

威尔逊在1930年经常访问奥韦尔路（O'well Rd.）的旧公寓。
麦克亨利后来才来。

C将抵押业务中获得的钻石戒指卖给了麦克亨利。

两人都访问过凡尔登露台41号，最后一次大约是
8月8日至14日？还有布莱恩亭（Pavilion Blen）。

威尔逊吹嘘说，如果这笔交易成功，他将退休并作为乘客返回美国。在同一场合，C非常友好，让L.J.l.摘下自己的祖母绿和钻石戒指，送给与他关系非常“密切”的麦克亨利。

当C和L.l.在船上见到他们时（八月的某一天），
带着包裹，露西·方丹夫人（Mrs. Lucy Fontaine）陪同他们。

自从婚姻出现问题以来，方丹夫人一直试图说服洛尔（Lol.）
把孩子安妮特给她，由麦克亨利收养？
非常努力？她还告诉L.l.，她和C在一起的时间快结束了。

去年八月、九月。告诉她写信给麦克亨利，让他寄3-4台老虎机来谋生。

照做了，解释了婚姻不和。

霍尔科姆少校（Major Holcomb）知道。之所以告诉他，是因为可能有一些牵连。

L.J.l.从M处得知威尔逊和麦克亨利已被捕。

威尔逊在C缺席去美国期间访问了L.J.l.。L.J.l.
拒绝往来，害怕他的性骚扰。
C回来后大发雷霆。他已安排W和L.l.一起去昆山（Qns）取一批铁皮罐头。

pages.en:
December 1, 1.

Dear Mr. Nicholson,

Many thanks for the loan of
the confidential file which I return herewith.

Yours sincerely,

Mr. M.R. Nicholson,
American Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1931年12月1日。

亲爱的尼科尔森先生：

非常感谢借阅机密档案，现随函归还。

此致

敬礼，

M.R.尼科尔森先生，

Deputy Commissioner
Crime Branch.
Divisional Officer,
"D" Division.

November 29, 1931.

Sir,

Enquiries re Contrabands.

I beg to report that No. 887 Yeong Zung Lee Alleyway
(House No. 87) connects East Seward Road on the north,
Hwakee Road on the west, Yu Ching Lee Alleyway on the east.
I have posted my assistants in the neighbourhood of Ah Lee's
house for the last three or four days, but they did not
notice anything peculiar.

From enquiries made, I have ascertained that this Ah
Lee has no connection with 95 Kungping Road (Municipal No.
1001). This man is at present unemployed. I have also
ascertained that there is no other person dealing in contra-
bands in the Wayside district with the name of Ah Lee.

Enquiries have also been made at 95 Kungping Road
(Municipal No. 1001) occupied by an office named Sing Meu.
The proprietor of the office is one Tsai Bah Ngai. The
office is managed by his son, Tsai Wu Lien, who lives in
1076 Doong Tsung Lee Alleyway, Broadway. A signboard with
the name of Yah Lee, ship's stevedore, is found at the
latter address. Tsai Wu Lien leaves his office at
7 o'clock every morning in his private ricsha and proceeds
to the Foreigners' camp, off the Race Course. I have followed
him in my private ricsha. I have been informed that he has
connections with officers of the camp in dealing with contrabands
which were imported from foreign ships to 1076 Doong Tsung Lee
Alleyway. As their movements have been kept very secret owing to
participation by foreigners, a watch has been kept by myself and
assistants at 1001 Kungping Road and 1076 Broadway. So far I
have not yet discovered any peculiar movements.

(sd) C.D.C. Shih Huai Ding c/o 2/1.
Report of W.S.Y. attached.
R.C.

Seen.
Enquiries are
being made re
Ah Lee residing
at Block 7
Yangtse Rd
Concession E. & L.
271. Shih
Hsien Ding
also makes a
statement that
Tsai is conducted
of dealing in
arms with
foreigners. Thereby
in the absence of
any information
of Ah Lee residing
in Sunyshan
Rd., as well
Shih's Search
Memoranda for
No. 1001, Kungping
Rd > 1076
Doong Sung Lee
Alleyway.
K. Commlr.
D. O. D.
pages.zh:
副总监
刑事科。
分区警官，
“D”区。

1931年11月29日。

先生，

关于违禁品的调查。

谨报告，永忠里887弄（门牌号87）北接东熙华德路（East Seward Road），西接华琪路（Hwakee Road），东接余庆里（Yu Ching Lee Alleyway）。过去三四天，我已在阿李家附近部署助手，但他们未注意到任何异常情况。

经查询，我查明此阿李与公平路95号（工部局编号1001）无关。此人目前失业。我还查明，在越界筑路地区没有其他名叫阿李的人从事违禁品交易。

还在公平路95号（工部局编号1001）进行了查询，该处由一家名为“星茂”（Sing Meu）的公司占用。该公司业主为蔡伯艾（Tsai Bah Ngai）。公司由其子蔡武连（Tsai Wu Lien）管理，他住在百老汇路（Broadway）东宗里1076号。在后一地址发现一块写有“耶李，轮船装卸工”（Yah Lee, ship's stevedore）名字的招牌。蔡武连每天早上7点乘坐私人黄包车离开办公室，前往跑马厅附近的外国人营地。我用私人黄包车跟踪了他。据告知，他在处理从外国船只进口到东宗里1076号的违禁品方面，与营地军官有联系。由于有外国人参与，他们的行动非常保密，我和助手一直在公平路1001号和百老汇路1076号进行监视。到目前为止，我尚未发现任何异常举动。

（签名）C.D.C. 施怀鼎（Shih Huai Ding）转交 2/1。
附W.S.Y.的报告。
R.C.

（左侧手写批注）：
已阅。
正在就居住在
长江路7号街区
公共租界东区及西区
271号的阿李
进行调查。施
贤鼎（Shih Hsien Ding）
也陈述称，
蔡某与
外国人进行
军火交易。因此，
在缺乏
居住在孙逸仙路（Sunyshan Rd.）
的阿李的任何信息的情况下，
以及施的
搜索备忘录
针对公平路1001号 > 东宋里（Doong Sung Lee）
1076弄。
K. 专员
D. O. D.

pages.en:
F. 28
R. S. S. Henderson.
Divisional Office “ C . ”
27- 11 - 1931.

Sir,

No 95. Kungping Rd in the Landlord's number, the
Council's, No. 1001. Kungping Rd. These premises are
occupied by Sing Wow, Co, suppliers of vegetables
to foreign ships, and camps.

pages.zh:
关于克劳利（Crawley）的情报。

大东饭店 47 号房间。
住客姓名登记为 Bang Chig Tsah：是一名军人，来自河南。然而，他的信件大多来自河南，收件人却是 Pei San Daung。
有外国人来访，描述无疑就是克劳利，仆人们都认识他。上次来访大约在 1 周前。
该住客还有另一位访客，一名高大的中国人，身高 6 英尺，长脸，留着小胡子。26 日当天在此停留至晚上 8 点，随后与住客一同乘坐 3025 号汽车离开。此前住客曾致电 27812 号电话。该住客于 1931 年 11 月 4 日抵达本饭店。

84 号房间。自 6 月 30 日起由第十九路军的 Liang Ding Hsi 居住。
常有众多人员往来，有时每晚多达 15 或 16 人，均为军人或上层阶级的广东人，且全是广东籍。
已知克劳利上次来访是在三个月前。
其他查询的信息尚未收到。
A.M. Richardson。

R. C. Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai, China.

Dear Mr. Aiers,

I am enclosing herewith data on Paul S. Crawley since the Chaumont affair. As this data is part of my office files please take what ever notes from it you may desire and return the file to me in due course.

I am also enclosing two cards with photographs and data relative to Lucy Crawley, alleged wife of Paul. These cards you may keep for your files.

Please consider the whole matter strictly confidential.

Thanking you for your kind co-operation, I am

Faithfully yours,

M. R. Nicholson
Treasury Attaché

露西·伊万诺夫（Lucy Ivanoff），又名 L. J. 伊万诺娃（L. J. Ivanova），又名朱莉娅·伊万诺娃（Julia Ivanova），又名保罗·S·克劳利夫人。

一名名为 Malekoff 的俄罗斯人，受雇于中国公安局（护照科），正试图协助克劳利夫人获得签证。
涉嫌与克劳利于 1931 年 8 月 12 日将鸦片和钻石装上美国舰船“肖蒙号”（U. S. S. Chaumont）。

露西·伊万诺夫，又名 L. J. 伊万诺娃，又名朱莉娅·伊万诺娃，又名保罗·S·克劳利夫人。
过往经历见秘密档案。保罗·S·克劳利的伴侣，在大连、上海、苏州、广州之间从事军火走私和毒品交易的同伙。
出生地 - 俄罗斯基辅 - 1905 年。
持有中国护照，号码 C1503，于 1929 年 8 月 12 日以 L. J. 伊万诺娃的名义签发。

关于 P.S. 克劳利的进一步信息。摘自 M 的档案。

地址霞飞路 832 号，克劳利经常独自前往。据说在那里煮制鸦片。这是已故朱宝斋（Chu Pao Sai）的地址。
其子 Zih Lau Sai 偶尔住在那里，那是他正式妻子的家。Zih Lau Sai 于 1931 年 2 月 11 日被绑架。克劳利在马斯南路 96 号有妾室和真正的家。据说其母亲在该宅邸病危。
费里路 12b 弄 4 号的施先生（Mr Shih）或 Sih 先生，据信是 Zih Lau Sai 的哥哥 Zih Kiang Sung。大哥住在西摩路 93 号。尽管他们知道绑匪是谁，但两人都拒绝与我们讨论 Zih Lau Sai 被绑架一事。
潘先生（Mr Pan）被提及为臭名昭著的军火商。住所司徒雷登路 14 号。办公室金神路 25 号。经营防弹背心和手枪钢笔。此前曾与一名外国人在此业务上有合作关系。克劳利经常去办公室见潘先生。

拥有摩托车牌号 2622。经常拜访克劳利的家。

盖达先生（或女士）（Mr(or Mrs) Gaida），著名的海洛因贩运者。克劳利的朋友。即将返回上海。

"B"
B/Well.

Correction & addition to information, re P.S. Crawley.
Page 1 & 2. U.S. Marine mentioned was named Hailley.
Page 2. Crawley was fined U.S. G.$ 500.00. Not. M. $ 5000.00.
Page 2. Chauffeur Merkervich has only "provisional driving permit, which
does not refer to Crawley's car. Informant has informed French
Police, and instructed them to cancel her name as owner of the C:
Crawley car.
Page 2 & 3. Ah Lee has an office for ship comprador business, in the nam
name of " Sing Mao" address 1001 Kungping Road. Note this is
old number.
Page 3. Knight Crawley is believed to be on his way back to Shanghai.
His paramour, named " Margaret" is daughter of proprietor of
"Ermak" restaurant No. 432 Avenue Joffre, is expecting him. She
is ex-dancer from Del Monte.
P.S. Crawley frequents room No 84.Great Eastern Hotel, and meets
there a Chinese named Ip Kwan.
Page 3. Reference to pistols in Lincoln M/Car. These were seen after K.
Crawley returned with P.S. from Hong Kong.
Page 5. Re' Nicholson, informant qualified word " assisted" Crawley, re
import of pianos etc. Says that Nicholson afterwards told China
Finance Corp'n not to mortgage, as they are stolen property.
Says Crawley advertises in N.C.D.N. re' buying pawntickets,"
"replies treated in strictest confidence."
The above corrections were made when informant was interviewed
on the 16-II-31. The rest of the report is correct.
She has several letters received from him since our last inter-
-view, in which Crawley implores informant to return to him be-
-cause of an important business in which he will shortly need
her assistance. One message also, written on the back of a rel-
-igious print which reads like the vapouring of one mentally afflict-
-ed. His children report to informant that he is now taking
an increasing quantity of opium each day.
pages.zh:
"B"
B/Well.

关于 P.S. 克劳利信息的更正与补充。
第 1 和 2 页。提到的美国海军陆战队员名叫 Hailley。
第 2 页。克劳利被罚款 500.00 美元。并非 5000.00 墨西哥元。
第 2 页。司机 Merkervich 仅持有“临时驾驶执照”，该执照并不适用于克劳利的汽车。线人已告知法国警察，并指示他们取消她作为克劳利汽车车主的登记姓名。
第 2 和 3 页。阿李有一个以“盛茂”（Sing Mao）名义注册的船舶买办业务办公室，地址公平路 1001 号。注意这是旧门牌号。
第 3 页。奈特·克劳利（Knight Crawley）据信正在返回上海途中。他的情妇，名叫“玛格丽特”，是霞飞路 432 号“埃尔马克”（Ermak）餐厅老板的女儿，正期待着他归来。她是前蒙特赌场（Del Monte）的舞女。
P.S. 克劳利经常出入大东饭店 84 号房间，并在那里会见一名叫叶冠（Ip Kwan，音译）的中国人。
第 3 页。关于林肯牌汽车中的手枪。这些手枪是在 K. 克劳利与 P.S. 从香港返回后被看到的。
第 5 页。关于尼科尔森（Nicholson），线人对“协助”克劳利进口钢琴等物品的说法进行了限定。称尼科尔森后来告诉中国金融公司不要接受抵押，因为它们是赃物。称克劳利在《字林西报》（N.C.D.N.）上刊登广告收购当票，“回复将严格保密”。
上述更正是于 1931 年 2 月 16 日询问线人时作出的。报告的其余部分是正确的。
自我们上次面谈以来，她收到了他寄来的几封信，信中克劳利恳求线人回到他身边，因为他有一项重要业务，很快就需要她的协助。还有一条信息，写在一张宗教印刷品的背面，读起来像是精神受创者的胡言乱语。他的孩子们向线人报告说，他现在每天吸食鸦片的数量日益增加。

Information re' Mr F.
Volunteered by Lucy J Ivanoff.

First met in Harbin, when co-habiting with suspect re' the
Goldenberg murder of 1922.
1923
Visited suspect at the Great World Hotel, hostensibly to take
his finger prints, but they were never taken. Went out with
suspect, who later returned and said" He's alright now. I got
him a "first time piece' and he won't worry us again."
Visited suspect several times afterwards at same place, enquiring
re' Ash(Ca.'t) and subsequently, it is believes that Ash was turned
over to F to return to Shanghai.
On occasions of visits, was very rude to informant.
Met suspect again frequently in Shanghai.
Principally during 1930, when living in vicinity of B'well and
Seymour Rd corner. Suspect had a flat at No 22I B'well Rd, corner
of Seymour. Garage at rear, and F and suspect used to converse
there, and something passed between them each time,(hand to hand)
Same time as Kn.C. in Shanghai.
F had several very secret conversations with suspect in the flat.
Very nervous, and suspect upbraided lift attendant for stopping
on same floor. F always left by stairway instead of lift.
Informant not allowed near on these occasions.
Suspect in habit of visiting F's flat recently. Has said how well
furnished, and convenient, and expressed wish to remove theree
pages.zh:
关于 F 先生的信息。
由露西·J·伊万诺夫自愿提供。

初次见面是在哈尔滨，当时她与嫌疑人同居，涉及 1922 年的戈尔登伯格（Goldenberg）谋杀案。
1923 年
在大世界酒店拜访嫌疑人，名义上是提取他的指纹，但从未提取。与嫌疑人一同外出，嫌疑人后来回来说：“他现在没事了。我给他搞了一把‘初犯用的枪’，他不会再烦扰我们了。”
此后多次在同一地点拜访嫌疑人，询问关于 Ash（船长）的情况，随后，据信 Ash 被移交给 F 以返回上海。
在拜访期间，对线人非常粗鲁。
在上海又频繁与嫌疑人见面。
主要是在 1930 年，当时住在百老汇路（B'well）和西摩路拐角附近。嫌疑人在百老汇路 221 号有一套公寓，位于西摩路拐角。后面有车库，F 和嫌疑人常在那里交谈，每次都有东西在他们之间传递（手递手）。
这与奈特·克劳利（Kn.C.）在上海的时间相同。
F 与嫌疑人在公寓内进行过几次非常秘密的谈话。
非常紧张，嫌疑人还斥责电梯服务员停在同一楼层。F 总是走楼梯而不是乘电梯离开。
在这些场合，线人不允许靠近。
嫌疑人最近习惯拜访 F 的公寓。曾说那里家具齐全，很方便，并表示希望搬进去

Information volunteered by Lucy Granoff. Russian.
Sheet.(I).
On the 11-11-31. by appointment, the above named lady was interviewed,
(by the undersigned )
and the following information was volunteered by her.
(Harbin)
She met Mr P S. Crawley, U.S. Citizen. in Harbin, as the result of answer-
-ing an advertisement for a lady business assistant. Subsequently she
lived with him as his wife at room No 28. The New World Hotel, and contin-
-ued to do so until the 10-11-31, when she left him for continued ill
treatment, and threats against her life. At the time she met Crawley he
was engaged in arms dealing, drug trafficking and a cinema film venture.
Subsequently the informant discovered that Crawley had removed to Harbin,
from Shanghai, where he had been under suspicion regarding the " Golden-
berg" murder case of 1922. The story she subsequently heard was to the
effect that Goldenberg had been a partner of Crawley in an illegal venture
selling the film rights of a cinema film, "Way down East" after the original
had been stolen by them and copied.
The copy was sold to a Japanese named Takamura? of Tokio, who paid the
sum of $ 40/50,000.00 for the sole rights. His cheque for that amount pas-
-sed into the hands of Goldenberg, who cashed it on the day before his
murder was discovered.
Crawley was informed by one, Ramus, ( Now a Cinema Magnate in Madrid)
that Goldenberg was about to " double cross" him, and it is believed by
the informant that Crawley saw him at his home above the Victoria Cinema.
The next morning Crawley discovered Goldenberg dead in his room.
The money was missing, also a ring which the victim always wore, which
contained a distinctive diamond of very high cut. Subsequently Crawley
left Shanghai, and later met informant in Harbin, where he arrived in very
good financial circumstances, and the possessor of a diamond ring which
he had recut, or reset, by a Harbin jeweller named " Gaspe".
Subsequently, Mention was made of the ring, and Crawley warned informant
possessed
that it was as much as her life was worth to reveal that he had it. It was
subsequently disposed of when he visited U.S.A. and a cargo of arms was
bought with the proceeds. They were disposed of in Harbin, to Chinese.
In 1923. Crawley was running a Gambling den in Harbin, as well as the film
agency, and other ventures. One of his partners in crime was a U.S. Marine,

由俄罗斯人露西·格拉诺夫（Lucy Granoff）自愿提供的信息。
页 (I).
1931 年 11 月 11 日，经预约，上述女士接受了（由下文署名者）问询，
并自愿提供了以下信息。
（哈尔滨）
她在哈尔滨结识了美国公民 P S. 克劳利先生，原因是回应了一则招聘女性商务助理的广告。随后，她在新世界酒店 28 号房间与他以夫妻名义同居，并一直持续至 1931 年 11 月 10 日，当时她因遭受持续的虐待和生命威胁而离开他。当她结识克劳利时，他正从事军火交易、毒品贩卖以及电影放映项目。
随后，线人发现克劳利是从上海搬到哈尔滨的，他在上海时曾因涉及 1922 年的“戈尔登伯格”谋杀案而受到怀疑。她后来听到的故事大致如下：戈尔登伯格曾是克劳利在非法 venture 中的合伙人，该非法活动涉及出售电影《向东走》（Way down East）的电影版权，原版胶片被他们偷走并复制。
复制品卖给了东京的一位名叫 Takamura? 的日本人，此人支付了 40,000 至 50,000 美元以获得独家版权。那张金额的支票落入了戈尔登伯格手中，他在谋杀案被发现的前一天兑现了支票。
克劳利从拉穆斯（Ramus，现为马德里的电影大亨）处得知，戈尔登伯格正准备“背叛”他，线人相信克劳利在维多利亚电影院楼上的家中见到了他。第二天早上，克劳利发现戈尔登伯格死在他的房间里。
钱不见了，受害者常戴的一枚戒指也不见了，那枚戒指镶嵌着一颗切割工艺独特的高品质钻石。随后克劳利离开上海，后来在哈尔滨与线人相遇，当时他财务状况极佳，并拥有一枚由哈尔滨珠宝商“加斯佩”（Gaspe）重新切割或重镶的钻石戒指。
随后，提到了这枚戒指，克劳利警告线人，透露他拥有这枚戒指将危及她的生命。后来当他访问美国时，这枚戒指被处理掉了，所得款项用于购买一批军火。这批军火在哈尔滨卖给了中国人。
1923 年。克劳利在哈尔滨经营一家赌场，以及电影代理和其他业务。他的犯罪伙伴之一是一名美国海军陆战队员，

pages.en:
Sheet.2.
who deserted,and passed as a free citizen,on discharge papers forged by
Crawley.He was subsequently arrested, and Crawleys Gambling den was
raided, and he was fined $.5000.00 by Judge Lobinger.
Another accomplice was a man named "Aon" (Capt?). Crawley is said to have betrayed him to the S.M.P. who returned him to Shanghai for an
offence unknown.
Crawley himself later returned to Shanghai, where he carried on, until
now, traffic in arms and opium. (a case of hand grenades were seen, on
one occasion by Comp't.)
Regarding his present activities in Shanghai, Slot Machines. The first
batch were imported on the U.S.S. Chaumont during 1930. the interior
being filled with pistols.
Others were imported without passing the through the Customs, by arrange
-ment with the Stewards on the Maru boats. Stewards had keys to the ma-
-chines which contained pistols.
The last slot machines known to arrive, came on the Haiyan ? Maru and
Hayi ? Maru, Crawley took one consignment on the night of October. 31.st
but had to leave one,owing to suspicion that a trap had been set by
the Customs Authorities.
When taking delivery of contraband, the only assistant is his Russian
Chauffeur named Merkervich, who is not believed to be a willing helper.
Uses his own M/Car licence No. 6477.
Regarding this M/Car, Crawley is said to have had some trouble with the
U.S. Consular Authorities, and has been forced to pay a large sum of m
money because he evaded Customs duties when it was imported, on the
II/12-10-31.It is in the name of Mrs L.S. Crawley.
Crawley conducts an opium exporting business with one named "AH Lee" who
was formerly his comprador in the Velvet Ice Cream business ( Office at
101 Central Arcade)
Ah Lee, is said to be a short, heavy, Chinese and has a birthmark with
long hair attached, on his left cheek. He is now owner of the Ice Cream
Co: and is contractor to U.S. Navy vessels.
When the U.S.S. Chaumont brought Crawleys Slot Machines, a return cargo
pages.zh:
第2页。
此人逃亡，并凭借克劳利（Crawley）伪造的退伍文件冒充自由公民。他随后被捕，克劳利的赌博窝点被突击搜查，洛宾格（Lobinger）法官对其处以5000.00美元罚款。
另一名同伙是一名名为“Aon”（音译）（上尉？）的男子。据说克劳利向上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）出卖了他，警务处将其遣返上海，所涉罪名不详。
克劳利本人后来返回上海，直至目前一直从事军火和鸦片交易。（警员曾有一次目睹一批手榴弹。）
关于他目前在上海的活动，涉及老虎机。第一批老虎机于1930年通过美国海军舰艇“肖蒙特”号（U.S.S. Chaumont）进口，机器内部装满了手枪。
其他老虎机通过与日本邮船会社（Maru boats）上的服务员勾结，未经海关查验即进口。这些服务员持有装有手枪的老虎机的钥匙。
已知最后一批抵达的老虎机是随“海燕”丸（Haiyan Maru，原文不清）和“八一”丸（Hayi Maru，原文不清）运抵的。克劳利于10月31日夜间提取了一批货物，但因怀疑海关当局设下圈套，不得不留下一批未取。
在接收违禁品时，他唯一的助手是他的俄罗斯司机，名为梅尔科维奇（Merkervich，音译），据信该司机并非自愿协助。
克劳利使用其本人的机动车牌照，号码为6477。
关于这辆机动车，据说克劳利与美国领事当局发生过一些纠纷，并被迫支付了一大笔款项，因为该车在1931年10月12日进口时逃避了关税。车辆登记在L.S. 克劳利夫人名下。
克劳利与一名名为“阿李”（AH Lee，音译）的人合作经营鸦片出口业务，此人曾是克劳利在“天鹅绒冰淇淋”生意中的买办（办事处位于中央商场101号）。
据说阿李是一名身材矮小、体格壮实的中国人，左脸颊上有一块长着长毛的胎记。他现在是这家冰淇淋公司的老板，也是美国海军舰艇的食品承包商。
当美国海军舰艇“肖蒙特”号运送克劳利的老虎机时，据称回程装载了

Sheet. 3.
of opium is said to have been carried. Ah Lee took it aboard, when stock
ing the vessel with foodstuffs.
Informant has seen him " faking" a case of Del Monte Asparagus, i.e.
packing 5 Tael tins of opium between tins of vegetables and re-closing
the box, at the home of his parents in the Wayside district. ( This
address can be located by informant.)
The next shipment of arms, is expected on November 14.th.1931. arriv-
-ing on the U.S.S. Henderson. The person who is in charge of the con-
-signment is known as Carstairs.
(We have made enquiries and are informed that the Henderson is due on th
the 4.th. or 5.th.of December.)
Information obtained from Code message. Informant familiar with it.
Made by arranging alphabetical letters in proper order, alongside an-
-other set of alphabetical letters taken alph aphazardly out of a hat
in which they have been shuffled.
The Code is sometimes more confused, by messages, in which the 3.rd.
letter is only part of the code. Code book said to be kept in Major
Holcomb's Safe. Regarding Knight Crawley. brothers.
After the Widler case, K. Crawley. served sentence in U.S. Penetenti
iary. Returned to Shanghai April or May I930. P.S. Crawley was living
then in a flat at No. 22I. B/Well Road.
Knight brought with him a Lincoln Saloon M/Car, which he kept in a
garage beneath his brothers flat, Being friendly with the informant
Knight took her for a drive in the car and stopped on Lincoln Avenue
at a secluded spot, and then showed her why P.S. had assisted him to
get the machine past the Customs Officials.
Inserting a steel pin into a minute hole in the upholstery of the fro
front of the front seat, he was able to cause the whole partition to
open, and it was seen that the upholstery concealed a stock of . 380.
pistols and Leuger pistols.
These were subsequently sold to a Chinese; H.O. Tong. who is said to
be a 'personal friend.
Informant saw his cheque payable to K. Crawley, for $. 3800.00.
pages.zh:
第3页。
一批鸦片作为回程货物。阿李在为船只补给食品时将鸦片搬上船。
线人曾在其位于韦赛德区（Wayside district，音译）的父母家中，目睹他“伪造”一箱德尔·蒙特（Del Monte）芦笋，即在蔬菜罐头之间夹入5两装的鸦片听，然后重新封好箱子。（线人可以找到该地址。）
下一批军火预计于1931年11月14日抵达，由美国海军舰艇“亨德森”号（U.S.S. Henderson）运载。负责这批货物的人名为卡斯特斯（Carstairs，音译）。
（我们已进行查询，获悉“亨德森”号预计于12月4日或5日抵达。）
此情报得自密码电文。线人熟悉该密码。
该密码是将字母按正确顺序排列，旁边对应另一组从帽子中随机抽取并打乱的字母。
有时密码更为混乱，在某些电文中，第三个字母仅是密码的一部分。据说密码本保存在霍尔科姆（Holcomb，音译）少校的保险箱中。关于奈特·克劳利（Knight Crawley）兄弟。
在维德勒（Widler，音译）案件之后，K. 克劳利在美国联邦监狱服刑。他于1930年4月或5月返回上海。当时P.S. 克劳利居住在贝威尔路（B/Well Road，音译）221号的一套公寓里。
奈特带来了一辆林肯轿车，停放在其兄弟公寓楼下的车库里。由于与线人关系友好，奈特驾车带线人兜风，并在林肯大道（Lincoln Avenue）一处僻静地点停车，随后向她展示P.S. 如何协助他将车辆通过海关官员的检查。
他将一根钢针插入前排座椅前部装饰面的一个小孔中，从而能够打开整个隔板，可以看到装饰面下隐藏着一批.380口径手枪和鲁格（Leuger）手枪。
这些手枪随后卖给了一名中国人H.O. Tong（音译），据称他是奈特的“私人朋友”。
线人看到了他支付给K. 克劳利的支票，金额为3800.00美元。

pages.en:
Sheet. 4.
Knight shortly afterwards went to Hong kong, taking the M/Car, and P.S.
accompanied him. On their return with the car business relations became
strained because Knight found that P.S. was betraying him in dealings
with Bisberg & Col: Christy, with whom they were connected.
He then returned to U.S.A. taking the M/Car, containing on that trip
500. tins of opium, ingeniously packed in the secret compartment.
Informant heard that the opium found its way into Canada by aeroplane.
Knight Crawley, is now in Nevada U.S.A. having fallen foul of the Fed-
-eral Authorities, and other racketeers in California.
P.S.Crawley now resides at No 41. Verdun Terrace, F.Town.Before he left
the B/Well Rd address,he began to seriously assault Mrs Crawley.
This is said to be partly because Crawley believes that she is betraying
him, and partly because of family troubles
Informant alleges that during 1930 Crawley started to commit incestuous
assaults on his daughter, then about 11½ years of age.
Informant saw him on his return home early one morning, go to the child's
room in a state of nudity and lay over her with his face between her
legs. The child was afraid but submitted because Crawley threatened to
beat informant of whom the child, and her brother, (about the same age)
are very fond.
The next day her private parts,were sore and she complained to informant.
Further she is said to have broken down at her music lesson, at the Shan-
-hai American School, and told the music mistress.
Informant was sent for and informed, and advised to report to the Ameri-
-can Consulate. Informant states that she did so, but was told by Dr:
Sellest. that probably the child was only repeating what she herself had
taught, and the report was not entertained.
Subsequently the child has constantly complained that her father annoyed
her by inserting his finger inside her VAGINA. Recently she has attained
the age of puberty, and her father has started giving her expensive pre-
-sents, and since receiving them, the child has ceased to complain, so
the informant fears that incest is being committed.
Crawley is said to constantly interfere with female servants, so that
none will stay in his service,. Plenty of corroboration said to be ex
pages.zh:
第4页。
不久后，奈特带着那辆机动车前往香港，P.S. 陪同前往。他们携车返回后，商业关系变得紧张，因为奈特发现P.S. 在与他们有关联的比斯伯格公司（Bisberg & Col: Christy，音译）的交易中背叛了他。
随后他返回美国，同样带着那辆机动车，那次行程中，秘密隔层内巧妙地藏有500听鸦片。
线人听说这批鸦片通过飞机运入了加拿大。
奈特·克劳利现在美国内华达州，因与美国联邦当局以及加利福尼亚州的其他敲诈勒索者发生冲突而陷入困境。
P.S. 克劳利现居住于法租界凡尔登台（Verdun Terrace, F.Town）41号。在离开贝威尔路（B/Well Rd）住址之前，他开始严重殴打克劳利夫人。
据说这部分是因为克劳利认为她背叛了他，部分是因为家庭纠纷。
线人指控，在1930年间，克劳利开始对他当时约11岁半的女儿实施乱伦性质的侵犯。
线人目睹他在某天清晨回家时，赤身裸体地走进孩子的房间，趴在她身上，脸部位于她的双腿之间。孩子虽然害怕，但因克劳利威胁要殴打线人——孩子和她的弟弟（年龄相仿）都非常喜欢线人——而被迫顺从。
第二天，她的私处疼痛，并向线人抱怨。此外，据说她在上海美国学校（Shanghai American School）的音乐课上情绪崩溃，并将此事告诉了音乐女教师。
线人被叫去并获知此事，有人建议她向美国领事馆报告。线人称她确实这样做了，但塞莱斯特医生（Dr: Sellest，音译）告诉她，这孩子可能只是在复述她自己教过的内容，因此该报告未被受理。
此后，孩子不断抱怨父亲将手指插入她的阴道来骚扰她。最近她已进入青春期，父亲开始送她昂贵的礼物，自从收到礼物后，孩子便不再抱怨，因此线人担心乱伦行为仍在继续。
据说克劳利经常骚扰女性仆人，导致无人愿意在他家做工。据说有大量佐证可

pages.en:
Sheet. 5.
attainable, and we have been asked to interveiw the child now 12. years
of age, re the above, to judge the truth of these statements ourselves.
The U.S.Consular Authorities have been further warned by informant,
but refuse to credit her story. There seems to be adequate corrobor-
-ation of the assaults by Crawley on informant.
On the 25-10-31 he threatened to kill her for " squealing" to the U.S.
Consulate and serverely beat her, also inflicting a knife wound on the
thigh. On the 26-10-31. the wounds were seen at a mutual friends home
by P/S. Cox(S.M.P. ) and his wife.
On the same date informant complained to Dr: Sellett, and was examin-
-ed and treated by Dr: Nance. She stated that Dr: Sellett did not take
any action, against Crawley but referred her to Mr Nicholson, investi-
-gator attached to the U.S. Consulate.
He told her that the only chance she had of getting justice was to be-
-tray the whole of Crawley's secrets. This she refused to do to Nich-
-olson. She states that Nicholson knows that Crawley shipped a consign-
-ment of Opium to U.S.A. by the U.S.S. Chaumont during 1930, ( The retur
-urn trip after bringing Crawley's Slot Machines.)
Nicholson is said to have assisted Crawley to import a cargo of pianos,
and gramophone records which were subject to Customs search, which
Crawley characterised as being "to late", as he had been too smart for
them. Crawley also buys pawntickets relating to jewellery.
During Oct: 1931. a lady, subsequently discovered to be Mrs Leubbert,
wife of Leubberts Pharmacy proprietor, took two tickets re diamond
rings to sell to him. Informant was alone & gave a receipt for them
but Mrs Leubbert was stayed a while and was very inquisitive regarding
informant.
She returned and saw Crawley, but did no business with the ticket.
Later informant drove them to various pawnshops, on their pretext of vei
viewing jewellery, but none was bought. The object being apparently
an excuse to discuss other business whilst having a legitimate reason
for being together.
It is understood that Leubbert does a mysterious import business,
(which we had heard rumours before) and Nicholson ( forementioned)
pages.zh:
第5页。
以获取，我们被要求面谈这名现年12岁的女孩，以就上述情况亲自判断这些陈述的真实性。
线人进一步警告了美国领事当局，但他们拒绝相信她的说法。关于克劳利对线人的袭击，似乎有足够的佐证。
1931年10月25日，他威胁要因为她向美国领事馆“告密”而杀死她，并严重殴打她，还在她的大腿上刺了一刀。1931年10月26日，公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的考克斯巡佐（P/S. Cox）及其妻子在一位共同朋友家中看到了这些伤口。
同日，线人向塞莱特医生（Dr: Sellett，音译）投诉，并由南斯医生（Dr: Nance，音译）进行检查和治疗。她表示，塞莱特医生并未对克劳利采取任何行动，而是将她转介给附属于美国领事馆的调查员尼科尔森先生（Mr Nicholson）。
尼科尔森告诉她，她获得公正对待的唯一机会是揭露克劳利的全部秘密。她拒绝向尼科尔森这样做。她声称尼科尔森知道克劳利在1930年通过美国海军舰艇“肖蒙特”号（即在运送克劳利的老虎机后的回程中）向美国运送了一批鸦片。
据说尼科尔森曾协助克劳利进口一批钢琴和留声机唱片，这些货物本应接受海关检查，但克劳利称海关“太晚了”，因为他比他们更聪明。克劳利还购买与珠宝有关的当票。
1931年10月期间，一位女士（后被发现是鲁伯特药房 proprietor 鲁伯特的妻子鲁伯特夫人）拿着两张钻石戒指的当票去找他出售。当时线人独自一人在场并出具了收据，但鲁伯特夫人停留了一会儿，并对线人非常好奇。
她回来见了克劳利，但没有就当票达成交易。后来线人以查看珠宝为借口，开车带他们去了各家当铺，但并未购买任何物品。其目的显然是一个借口，以便在有正当理由在一起的同时讨论其他业务。
据了解，鲁伯特从事神秘的进口业务（我们此前已听到相关传闻），而尼科尔森（前述）

pages.en:
Sheet. 6.
is an associate.
Mrs Leubbert subsequently visited Crawley at his home on Oct: 3I.st: &
had a confidential conversation, regarding which nothing is known.
On the night of the 9-II-3I. Crawley again assaulted informant, and con-
-tinued to do so through the night, so that in the early morning of the
IO.th. she ran away in her night attire, being unable to obtain other elc
clothing, and took refuge with the wife of a Mr Quinell (late Cap't)
formerly of the Stadium, at No 295 Rue Bougeat, where she now resides.
On the IO-II-3I. Quinell observed a foreigner in plain clothes patrolling
outside the house, and on accosting him, was informed that he was a mem-
ber of the International Police. He remained there until the IIth. We
are unable to account for him. He is described as being British and ab-
-out 6. ft. tall.
Crawley often patrols the vicinity in his M/Car, and is said to be al-
-ways armed. (We have heard of this before)
Regarding the opium smuggling on U.S. Naval vessels, there is some cor-
-roboration of this. The U.S. Marine Corp's Provost Martial is at present
conducting enquiries regarding Marines known to be visitors of Crawley,
owing to information having been received, that Marines returning to U.S.
on transports carry contraband for him. The P.M. has certain evidence
and often confers with us regarding Crawley.
D.P.S. Croden heard the whole of informant's story except the indecency
complaint. We have been asked to see informant for more details.
We shall do so, and check up this report, which may contain slight
discrepancies, as it has been transcribed from rough notes only.
Informant's motive in giving these details to us, she states, is not
merely revenge, but to assist the Police to put Crawley where he cannot
harm her, as she fears for her life and dare not leave her room to ob-
-tain a situation.
It is said Crawley said to frequent No. Aberq O'way. Second hand store.
Proprietor. G. Meddins. Reason unknown. but latter said to have
been a "crook" formerly.
(印：Shields S.I.)

是其同伙。
鲁伯特夫人随后于10月31日在家中拜访了克劳利，并进行了一次秘密谈话，具体内容无人知晓。
1931年11月9日夜间，克劳利再次袭击线人，并整夜持续施暴，以至于10日凌晨，她身穿睡衣逃离，因无法取得其他衣物，便躲藏在 formerly 体育场（Stadium）的昆内尔先生（Mr Quinell，前上尉）的妻子家中，地址为蒲石路（Rue Bougeat）295号，她目前居住于此。
1931年11月10日，昆内尔观察到一名便衣外国人在屋外巡逻，上前询问时，对方自称是国际警察的一员。他一直逗留到11日。我们无法解释他的身份。据描述，此人为英国人，身高约6英尺。
克劳利经常驾驶他的机动车在该地区巡逻，据说总是携带武器。（我们此前已听说过此事。）
关于在美国海军舰艇上走私鸦片一事，有一些佐证。美国海军陆战队宪兵司令目前正在对已知是克劳利访客的海军陆战队员进行调查，因为收到情报称，乘坐运输船返回美国的海军陆战队员为他携带违禁品。宪兵司令掌握某些证据，并经常就克劳利一事与我们磋商。
副警务总监克罗登（D.P.S. Croden）听取了线人的全部陈述，除了有关猥亵的指控。我们被要求再见线人以获取更多细节。
我们将这样做，并核实这份报告，由于该报告仅根据粗略笔记转录，可能包含细微出入。
线人向我们提供这些细节的动机，她声称，不仅仅是为了报复，而是为了协助警方将克劳利置于无法伤害她的境地，因为她担心自己的生命安危，不敢离开房间去寻找工作。
据说克劳利经常光顾阿伯克奥威（Aberq O'way，音译）二号二手商店。店主为G. 梅丁斯（G. Meddins）。原因不明，但据说后者以前是个“罪犯”。
（印章：Shields S.I.）

Confidential Memorandum for R. C. Aires, Esquire, Deputy Commissioner of
Police - Shanghai, China.

On the night of August 12th, 1931, one McHenry, chief boatswain
of the U. S. S. Chaumont, then in port, visited the home of Paul S.
Crawley, 41 Verdun Terrace and there was introduced to a Russian woman,
here referred to as Mrs. X, who was a close personal friend of Crawley's
common-law wife, Lucy Crawley, alias Lucy Ivanoff.

The party of four had some refreshments in Crawley's house
after which they took a package containing one bottle of whiskey and
55 - 3 tael tins of opium in Crawley's motor car to the river front at
or adjacent to the Customs Jetty. Here McHenry hired a launch and the
four proceeded to the U. S. S. Chaumont in mid-stream, opposite the
French Bund. McHenry together with one or both of the women went aboard
the Chaumont and deposited the package containing the opium in his cabin.

They returned finally to Shanghai where the four went to the
Blue Pavilion Cafe on Avenue Joffre and had some dinner on the front
verandah upstairs. Later in the evening the party separated and McHenry
took Mrs. X to her home.

The opium contained in the package which was put aboard the
Chaumont was purchased in the raw state in two different places in French
Town. The raw opium consisted of two balls and one brick, which would
indicate that it was two-thirds imported opium and one-third native opium.
This raw opium was cooked and prepared for smoking by Mr. Sih, said to be
the son of the late Chu Pao San, at his residence #838 Avenue Joffre. The
tins containing the opium were obtained by Ah Li of Tongshang Road and
Paul S. Crawley from a small shop in a lane off Rue du Consulat. These
pages.zh:
致中国上海警务处副总监 R. C. Aires 先生的机密备忘录。

1931年8月12日晚，当时停泊在港的美国军舰“肖蒙特号”（U. S. S. Chaumont）的水手长麦克亨利（McHenry）造访了住在凡尔登台41号（Verdun Terrace）的保罗·S·克劳利（Paul S. Crawley）的家，并在那里被介绍给一位俄国女子，此处称为X夫人，她是克劳利的同居妻子露西·克劳利（Lucy Crawley），又名露西·伊万诺夫（Lucy Ivanoff）的亲密私人朋友。

这四人在克劳利家中享用了一些茶点后，乘坐克劳利的汽车，携带一个装有一瓶威士忌和55罐每罐3两重的鸦片的包裹，前往海关码头或其附近的江边。在此处，麦克亨利租用了一艘小艇，四人乘艇前往停泊在法外滩对面江心的“肖蒙特号”。麦克亨利与其中一名或两名女性登上“肖蒙特号”，并将装有鸦片的包裹存放在他的船舱内。

他们最终返回上海，四人前往霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的蓝亭咖啡馆（Blue Pavilion Cafe），在楼上的前廊用晚餐。当晚晚些时候，众人散去，麦克亨利送X夫人回家。

装上“肖蒙特号”的包裹中的鸦片是在法租界两个不同地方购买的生鸦片。生鸦片由两个球状和一个砖状组成，这表明其中三分之二为进口鸦片，三分之一为本土鸦片。这些生鸦片由施先生（Mr. Sih，据称是已故朱宝三的儿子）在其霞飞路838号的住所煮制并加工成可供吸食的形态。装鸦片的锡罐是由通商路的阿李（Ah Li）和保罗·S·克劳利从领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）一条弄堂里的一家小店获得的。这些

pages.en:
- 2 -

tins were made specially to order and were patterned after the style
of tins used for packing Macao opium. Lucy Crawley personally packed
the opium in the tins and soldered them up. The tins were then tied
in eleven bundles of five tins each and the whole enclosed in newspaper
wrapping with an outside wrapping of brown paper.

Dated, Shanghai, China, December 8th, 1931
pages.zh:
- 2 -

锡罐是特别定制的，仿照包装澳门鸦片的锡罐样式。露西·克劳利亲自将鸦片装入锡罐并焊接封口。随后，这些锡罐被捆扎成十一束，每束五罐，整体先用报纸包裹，外层再用牛皮纸包裹。

日期：1931年12月8日，中国上海

Tsingtau China,
Dec. 5th - 1931.

To Hamilton Esq.

That Lucy Julia Ivanoff
Crawley comes from a very nice home in
Russia, her father is a worthy Gentleman,
and Lucy came to me just shortly after she
left the Convent School at Tsingtau, China.
and has stood by me loyally in my business
and has taken care of my children faithfully,
she nursed them through illnesses and was
always kind to and
cared for them as if they were her own x
During my absence in the U.S.A. in 1930. I
left my wife in charge of my business
she was faithful to her trust and
had to do all the hard work of
a manly nature which few women in a
hundred could do, and I truly
believe that during these seventy days
absence that she was faithful x
And I regret if I had not seen her in the
presence of her friends on the 6th Dec 1931.
with Esteem & Respect R S Crawley
pages.zh:
中国青岛，
1931年12月5日。

致 Hamilton 先生：

露西·朱莉娅·伊万诺夫·克劳利来自俄罗斯一个很好的家庭，她的父亲是一位可敬的绅士。露西在中国青岛离开修道院学校后不久就来到我这里，在我的生意中一直忠诚地支持我，并忠实地照顾我的孩子，在他们生病时护理他们，始终善待并照顾他们，就像对待自己的孩子一样 x
1930年我在美国期间，我让我的妻子负责我的生意。她忠于所托，承担了许多具有男性性质的艰苦工作，这是百里挑一的女性才能做到的。我真心相信，在这七十天的缺席期间，她是忠诚的 x
如果我在1931年12月6日未能在她的朋友面前见到她，我深感遗憾。

致以敬意与尊重
R S 克劳利

CONFIDENTIAL
Confidential Memo for Commissioner Aires - C. I. D.

Bowhill & Co.:

This firm was engaged in curio business at No. 2 Canton Road,
Rooms 209 -212. Mr. Bowhill was in charge. The firm became
bankrupt - failing to pay rent, etc. Closed out by Lester,
Johnson & Morris believed some time in May, 1931.

There was connected with this firm an individual who signed himself
to personal letters as "Jim". This "Jim" formerly lived at 103
Route Vallon and later at 766-B Avenue Joffre. The latter premises
consist of 3 room apartment for past few months occupied by a Mr. &
Mrs. Friman, who state they know nothing about "Jim" or Bowhill.

"Jim" was connected with Knight Crawley apparently in arms and
ammunition and evidently knows Paul S. The following letter was
apprehended in a raid on Knight Crawley's home at Beverly Hills,
Hollywood, California, during October, 1931:-

"(All communications should be addressed to P. O. Box 886)

BOWHILL AND COMPANY
MERCHANTS
Rooms 209-212, No. 2 Canton Road
SHANGHAI

Knight M. Crawley, Esquire,                      November 1, 1930.
c/o Mrs. Paul Melcan,
Box 784,
Taft, Calif.,
U. S. A.

Dear Knight,

I am in receipt of your letter from Seattle,
no date, but the date on the envelope is 5th Sept. This has just
reached me, I cannot understand the delay. As I told you in my last
letter I am not living at 103 Route Valon any longer, staying at
766-B, Avenue Joffre. The box number on top of this paper will always
find me and it will be much better for you to address me the box
number always. I am sorry about the goods that you had from Mr. Ong.
I actually thought that everything would be in order and it is too bad
that you have had to run back and forth between Mexico and Canada.
There must be a lot of kick backs. Now you have had to go back to
Vancouver, it is just possible that the stuff could have been sold
out in the first place which would have saved a lot of trouble in
everyway. I do hope you will be able to arrange about the two lakh.
I will not discuss your brother; that is very difficult thing to
do, it is just what one expects him to do arrive on steamer, without
letting anyone know what he was doing. He has been in no jam out here
to the best of my knowledge and that certainly would have been known
had anything happened in Shanghai. You will see by the paper we are

（左侧手写批注：）
Mrs Paul Melcan
is sister of Knight
and Paul S Crawley

（左下角手写批注：）
Dearest Paul

（右侧边缘竖排手写批注：）
Why was Danny
arrested?

致 Aires 总监 - 刑事侦缉处的机密备忘录

Bowhill 公司：

该公司在广东路2号209-212室经营古玩业务。由 Bowhill 先生负责。该公司破产——未能支付租金等。据信于1931年5月某时由 Lester, Johnson & Morris 清算结业。

与该公司有关联的一名个人在私人信件中署名为“Jim”。这位“Jim”此前住在瓦隆路103号，后来住在霞飞路766-B号。后一处房产为一套三居室公寓，过去几个月由 Friman 夫妇居住，他们声称对“Jim”或 Bowhill 一无所知。

“Jim”显然与 Knight Crawley 有武器和弹药方面的关联，并且显然认识 Paul S.。以下信件是在1931年10月突袭加利福尼亚州好莱坞比弗利山庄 Knight Crawley 的住所时查获的：-

“（所有通信请寄至邮政信箱886号）

BOWHILL AND COMPANY
商行
广东路2号209-212室
上海

Knight M. Crawley 先生，                      1930年11月1日。
转交 Mrs. Paul Melcan,
784号信箱，
塔夫特，加利福尼亚州，
美国。

亲爱的 Knight，

我收到了你从西雅图寄来的信，
没有日期，但信封上的日期是9月5日。这封信刚到我手中，我不明白为何延误。正如我在上一封信中告诉你的，我不再住在瓦隆路103号，而是住在霞飞路766-B号。这张纸顶部的信箱号码总能找到我，你最好一直使用信箱号码给我写信。对于你从 Ong 先生那里得到的货物，我感到抱歉。我原本以为一切都会井然有序，很糟糕的是你不得不在墨西哥和加拿大之间来回奔波。肯定有很多回扣问题。现在你不得不回到温哥华，很有可能这批货起初就可以卖掉，那样会在各方面省去很多麻烦。我真希望你能安排好那二十万的事宜。我不想讨论你的兄弟；那是一件很难办的事，这正是人们预料他会做的：乘轮船抵达，而不让任何人知道他在做什么。据我所知，他在这里没有陷入任何困境，如果上海发生了什么事，那肯定会为人所知。你会从报纸上看到我们

（左侧手写批注：）
Mrs Paul Melcan
是 Knight
和 Paul S Crawley 的姐妹

（左下角手写批注：）
最亲爱的 Paul

（右侧边缘竖排手写批注：）
Danny 为什么

QUESTIONS:

Who is "Jim" writer of letter to Knight Crawley? What are the
present whereabouts of Bowhill and present activities? What was nature
of his business at No. 2 Canton Road?

What is nature of K. Y. Chen's connection with Knight Crawley?

Any information re above will be appreciated. Perhaps Lester,
Johnson & Morriss can throw some light on "Jim" or Bowhill.

给 Knight Crawley 写信的“Jim”是谁？Bowhill 目前的下落和活动是什么？他在广东路2号的业务性质是什么？

K. Y. Chen 与 Knight Crawley 的关系性质是什么？

如果她坚持诽谤无辜者，就命令她离开办公室；因此确信 S 正在尽力庇护 Wilson。
她一直以为 W 是一名秘密特工，但鉴于他的行为，她可以发誓他正在背叛他的雇主。

4. 关于 F. I. R. 55/32。B'well。
被捕时持有鸦片（约 24 磅）的中国人（第一被告）自称名为 Hong Yong dung。他的真名是 Pan Ho Leling，以前是布匹商人，现在是兑换经纪人。住在哈米尼路（Hameni Rd.）9 号。已故父亲住在古岭路（Kuling Rd.）329 号。

一直在为 Zih Yih Sung 转移鸦片。
Zih 住在渡轮路（Ferry Rd.）12B 弄 4 号，他在克劳利（Crawley）被捕后的第二天害怕遭到突袭。
Zih 即将搬至哈米尼路（Hameni Rd.）10 号。
运输使用了车牌号为 480 的汽车。该车为 Nien Yuen Sung 所有。地址：哈米尼路（Hameni Rd.）186 号。
被告称，Pan 住在 Sun avenue，不是个体面人，从事军火交易。

connection. Says Zih is too big to be

allude to the number of connections

prior to his arrest.

pages.en:
Memo for Com Ahes
Ah Li

On evening of Nov. 5th Crawley & Chauffer
went to Whashing Road Jetty where a small
Motor boat in charge of a Lodah awaited
them. By this boat they proceeded to R.Y.K
Posting Wharf, which is directly opposite
Whashing Road, and there boarded the Jap.
S.S. Huya Maru. Went to barber shop
from which Crawley took away a slot machine
and a very heavy box. They returned to the
Bund placed the machine and box in Crawley's
motor car and proceeded to Ah Li's Almondore
Office at 95 Kengping Road where Ah Li was
awaiting them. All three (Crawley, Chauffer and
Ah Li) assisted in carrying the heavy box into
Ah Li's office. They (Crawley & Chauffer) then returned
home with the slot machine.

On the following day (Nov 6.) Crawley
visited Ah Li's office and held a long & intimate
conversation with him. That night again
visited Ah Li. Next morning (Nov 7) 10.30 to
11.30 A.M. Crawley left the house at Garden Lane
with one package (box) and went to Ah Li's
pages.zh:
致 Ahes 警官的备忘录
Ah Li

11 月 5 日晚，克劳利（Crawley）和司机
前往华兴路（Whashing Road）码头，那里有一艘由一名 Lodah 负责的小
摩托艇在等候他们。他们乘这艘船前往位于华兴路正对面的
R.Y.K 邮政码头，并在那里登上了日本
轮船“胡亚丸”号（S.S. Huya Maru）。去了理发店，
克劳利从那里拿走了一台老虎机和一个很重的箱子。他们回到
外滩，将机器和箱子放入克劳利的
汽车，然后前往肯平路（Kengping Road）95 号的 Ah Li 的 Almondore 办公室，Ah Li 正在那里等候他们。三人（克劳利、司机和
Ah Li）协助将重箱搬进 Ah Li 的办公室。随后他们（克劳利和司机）带着老虎机返回
家中。

次日（11 月 6 日），克劳利
拜访了 Ah Li 的办公室，并与他进行了长时间且亲密的谈话。当晚再次
拜访 Ah Li。第二天早上（11 月 7 日）10:30 至
11:30，克劳利带着一个包裹（箱子）离开花园弄（Garden Lane）的家，前往 Ah Li 处

pages.en:
2
On this occasion some bits of conversation
was overheard indicating that Ah Li was leaving
for "up river" at 5 PM that day with the heavy
box taken from Hija Maru. Returning home
Crawley made the statement that Ah Li was
going to Soochow that afternoon.
Later in the day Crawley had a heated
conversation with some-one on the telephone
evidently believed to be a Chinese. That
evening Crawley beat his wife as a result
of a discussion about money supposed to
be due Crawley from Ah Li part of which he had promised
his wife.
Since that date (Nov 7-1931) Crawley
has not visited Ah Li and it is therefore
possible that Ah Li has not returned to
Shanghai.
pages.zh:
2
在这次场合，听到了一些对话片段，表明 Ah Li 将于当天下午 5 点带着从“胡亚丸”号（Hija Maru）取下的重箱前往“上游”地区。回家后，克劳利声称 Ah Li 那天下午要去苏州。
当天晚些时候，克劳利与某人通电话时发生了激烈的争吵，此人显然被认为是一名中国人。那天晚上，克劳利因讨论一笔据称 Ah Li 欠他的钱而殴打妻子，他曾承诺将其中一部分钱给妻子。
自该日期（1931 年 11 月 7 日）以来，克劳利未再拜访 Ah Li，因此 Ah Li 可能尚未返回上海。

她称 L.J.I. 已不再住在那里。
在 C. 被捕后，S. 医生打电话给 Manley 夫人，告诉她 L.J.I. 精神失常，建议在麻烦发生前摆脱她。
他还打电话给 L.J.I.，据称在 Manley 夫人面前（通过电话）提出如果她离开本市，愿意支付她去任何外埠的路费。该提议被拒绝。鉴于上述情况，M. 夫人于 1932 年 1 月 19 日请来一位脑科专家对 L.J.I. 进行检查。Miheev 医生证明她没有显示出任何精神或神经疾病的迹象（呈送供您审阅，请退还。线人希望收回此证明）。
Fontaine 夫人也不断打电话到线人的公寓，提出付钱让 L.J.I. 去哈尔滨，并称上海有危险。
L.J.I. 随后与一位被称为 Lama “King” 的人同住。后者的名字取自一位 King 先生，据说受雇于 S.M.T. 公司，是 Hamilton（L.J.I. 的前朋友）的朋友，真实国籍为俄罗斯。地址：转交 Volkoff，电话 72591（据信是 Vallon 路 232 号）（于 1932 年 1 月 20 日搬迁）。
由于 Fontaine 和 S. 打来的更多电话，Manley 夫人说服市内的一户中国家庭允许 L.J.I. 与他们同住。她告诉其他人 L.J.I. 已去青岛。她从 S. 的行为趋势认为，S. 害怕 L.J.I. 知道一些他担心会被公开的事情。
当 L.J.I. 在 Volkoff 处与 Lama King 同住时，她像对大多数人那样讲述了自己的人生故事。
1932 年 1 月 24 日星期日，L. 的前朋友 Hamilton 拜访了 M. 夫人，要求见 L.，但未获得任何信息。
1932 年 1 月 27 日，Volkoff 打电话给 M. 夫人，称

Shanghai, March 2, 1932.

March 21, 1932

9 - 10 A. M. - At home.
10 - 12 noon - Keyes and chauffeur repaired and oiled
slot-machines at new workshop which Keyes
arranged behind his musical store at 580
Avenue Joffre.
12 noon - 2 P. M. - At home.
2 - 5 P. M. - Keyes and chauffeur out re slot-machines.
5 - 8 P. M. - At home.

Keyes asked the chauffeur if there is truth in Crawley's words
that chauffeur has ordered duplicates of slot-machine keys for the purpose
to steal money. Chauffeur is very much surprised by the said accusation and
going to ask Crawley to explain things. He is going to see Crawley to-day.

There are still three years until the end of Crawley's contract with
Mills, but chauffeur said that he might spoil it if he can prove that Crawley
cheated Mills by sending to the latter false accounts.

上午9 - 10点 - 在家。
上午10 - 12点 - 凯斯和司机在凯斯安排的新车间修理并润滑老虎机，该车间位于其音乐商店后方，地址为霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）580号。
中午12点 - 下午2点 - 在家。
下午2 - 5点 - 凯斯和司机因老虎机事宜外出。
下午5 - 8点 - 在家。

凯斯询问司机，克劳利所说司机为了偷钱而订购老虎机钥匙副本一事是否属实。司机对该指控感到非常惊讶，并打算要求克劳利解释清楚。他今天要去见克劳利。

距离克劳利与米尔斯公司的合同结束还有三年，但司机表示，如果他能证明克劳利通过向米尔斯公司发送虚假账目进行欺诈，他可能会破坏该合同。

2:00 P. M. - 3:30 P. M. Hilda and chauffeur out re slot-machines.

Before attending slot-machines, Hilda instructed chauffeur to take her to
Route Gaston Khan, where she disappeared in one of the alleyways inhabited
by Chinese population. She appeared again accompanied by an unknown Chinese
and instructed chauffeur to take them to the corner of Ferry & Bubbling Well
Road, where the above mentioned Chinese alighted. During the way Hilda and
the said Chinese had a very hot conversation in Chinese, which Hilda speaks
fluently. Chauffeur said that Hilda is often visited during the evening by
Chinese of both sexes. On several occasions a Chinese woman remained to
sleep in Crawley's house. All above mentioned Chinese are of well-to-do
class.

3:30 P. M. - 8:00 P. M. At home.

Yesterday chauffeur saw Crawley for the first time for many days,

Crawley was surprised when chauffeur told him about this and said that Hilda
always said that chauffeur himself doesn't want to visit him. Crawley said

and can be seen daily in his "Velvet Cafe" at Central Arcade.

Ex-Mrs. Crawley was not seen at Peking Road Jetty or at Hunts Wharf.
Inquiries made at 135 Route Sey Zoong, but landlady denied that she

Crawley's son is to be sent to Manila within a few days.

Reports state that keys which are in possession of Hilda
are slot-machine keys only.
The keys for the safe in Crawley's house and for the safe deposit
box in the Chekiang Industrial Bank are either in Crawley's possession or
in some secret place.
During yesterday's visit to Crawley, the latter and Hilda were
discussing the sale of the diamonds and various jewelry, which are in the
safes. Crawley said that he would see that his lawyer gets possession of it.
Opinion that Crawley will never give Hilda keys for the safes as
he is afraid she will take valuables and abscond.
The keys for slot-machines which are in Hilda's possession are
guarded by Hilda very carefully, as she is afraid that the chauffeur might
get hold of them, open a few slot-machines and take the money.

报告称，希尔达持有的钥匙仅为老虎机钥匙。
克劳利家中保险箱以及浙江实业银行保管箱的钥匙，要么在克劳利手中，要么藏在某个秘密地点。
在昨天拜访克劳利期间，后者与希尔达讨论了出售存放在保险箱内的钻石及各种珠宝事宜。克劳利表示，他会确保其律师取得这些物品的控制权。
观点认为，克劳利绝不会将保险箱钥匙交给希尔达，因为他担心她会拿走贵重物品并潜逃。
希尔达非常小心地保管着她所持有的老虎机钥匙，因为她担心司机可能会拿到钥匙，打开几台老虎机并取走里面的钱。

Shanghai, Jan. 26, 1932.

Jan. 25. 1932

9 - 10 A.M. - At home.
10 - 12 noon - Hilda visited Widler and later visited Major
Holcomb with a letter and last to Swiss Consul.
Chauffeur was instructed to visit U. S. Con-
sulate and gave to the Marshall some things &
Mills' cablegram to be handed over to Crawley.

12 - 3 P. M. - At home.

3 - 6 P. M. - Hilda and chauffeur cut re slot-machines.

6 - 8.30P.M. - At home.

Cablegram has been received from Mills' concern, in which
they demand G.$4000.00 to be paid for the slot-machines, threatening
to take machines away.

Crawley instructed Hilda and his lawyers to sell or pawn all
his property and pay bail for him and for slot-machines for Mills.
According to Crawley he hopes to raise $50,000.00.

The property known to the chauffeur consist of house furnish-
ing, motor cars(2), and over 50 slot-machines(including Mills').

上海，1932年1月26日。

1932年1月25日

上午9时至10时 - 在家。
上午10时至中午12时 - 希尔达拜访了维德勒（Widler），随后携带一封信拜访了霍尔科姆（Holcomb）少校，最后拜访了瑞士领事。
司机奉命前往美国领事馆，向马歇尔（Marshall）递交了一些物品及米尔斯（Mills）发给克劳利的电报。

中午12时至下午3时 - 在家。

下午3时至6时 - 希尔达与司机外出处理老虎机事务。

下午6时至8时30分 - 在家。

已收到来自米尔斯公司的电报，其中要求支付4,000.00金元以结清老虎机款项，并威胁要收回机器。

克劳利指示希尔达及其律师变卖或典当其所有财产，为他本人及米尔斯的老虎机缴纳保释金。据克劳利称，他希望筹集50,000.00美元。

司机所知的财产包括家居用品、两辆汽车以及50多台老虎机（包括米尔斯公司的）。

to give it to his boss.
11 a. m. - 12 noon.- Hilda and chauffeur to various places re
slot-machines. She took charge of the business. All money and signed
receipts.
12 noon - 2:30 p. m. at home.
2:30 - 3 p. m. To telegraph office wherefrom Hilda sent a wire to
Mills' concern about Crawley's arrest.
3 - 5 p. m. At home.
5 - 5:30 p. m. Hilda visited Mr. Hai on Ferry Road and was up
there for half an hour having tea with Hai.
5:30 - 7 p. m. at home.
7 - 8 p. m. Hilda and chauffeur re slot-machines.
pages.zh:
上海 - 32年1月11日
(#86)
克劳利神父（Father De Crawley，原文如此，疑为标题错误，应指克劳利相关）
1月9日
除克劳利于深夜被捕外，无其他趣事发生。
1月10日
上午10:30    希尔达·福斯特（Hilda Forster）与司机乘坐克劳利的汽车外出。
他们驱车前往斐伦路海先生（Mr. Hai）的家。她随身携带一个用餐巾包裹的包裹，并交给海先生的仆人，指示其转交给老板。
上午11时 - 中午12时    希尔达与司机前往多处处理老虎机事务。她接管了业务。收取所有款项及签署收据。
中午12时 - 下午2:30    在家。
下午2:30 - 3时    前往电报局，希尔达从那里向米尔斯公司发送关于克劳利被捕的电报。
下午3时 - 5时    在家。
下午5时 - 5:30    希尔达前往斐伦路拜访海先生，并与海先生喝茶半小时。
下午5:30 - 7时    在家。
下午7时 - 8时    希尔达与司机处理老虎机事务。

pages.en:
(#67)
Further Re Crawley
January 11th
10:30 a. m. - 12:30 p. m. Hilda visited Mr. Schuhl's office
12:30 - 1 p. m. She drove to Hai house, but seeing police in the
alleyway quickly reversed car and drove away.
1 - 8 p. m. at home.
8 - 11 p. m. Hilda and chauffeur out re slot-machines.
pages.zh:
(#67)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1月11日
上午10:30 - 下午12:30    希尔达拜访舒尔（Schuhl）先生的办公室
下午12:30 - 1时    她驱车前往海先生家，但看到巷子里有警察，迅速倒车离开。
下午1时 - 8时    在家。
下午8时 - 11时    希尔达与司机外出处理老虎机事务。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China,

(#85)
Further re Crawley
January 8th, 1932

9 a. m. - 3 p. m. Crawley was staying at home. During this
time he several times sent chauffeur and his new Chinese employee out re
slot-machines.

3 - 4 p. m. Crawley to see Widler alone.
4 - 5 p. m. At home
At 5 p. m. Crawley, Miss Hilda, chauffeur and Chinese to 12-b,
house No. 4 Ferry Road to see Mr. Hai. The latter was out and party proceeded
to various places re slot-machines.
8 p. m. - Returned home.
8 - 8:30 p. m. - At home.
At 8 P. M. - Crawley left by car alone. Before leaving he told
Hilda that he was going to see Mr. Hai.
Crawley was not back at 10 p. m.
pages.zh:
中国上海，

(#85)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1932年1月8日

上午9时 - 下午3时    克劳利待在家中。在此期间，他多次派遣司机和他的新中国雇员外出处理老虎机事务。

下午3时 - 4时    克劳利单独会见维德勒（Widler）。
下午4时 - 5时    在家
下午5时    克劳利、希尔达小姐、司机及一名中国雇员前往斐伦路4号12-b室拜访海先生。后者不在，众人遂前往多处处理老虎机事务。
下午8时 - 返回家中。
下午8时 - 8时30分 - 在家。
下午8时 - 克劳利独自驾车离开。离开前他告诉希尔达，他要去看望海先生。
克劳利在晚上10时仍未回来。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

(#84)
Further re Crawley
January 7th

9 A. M. - 4:30 P. M. Crawley was staying at home. The chauffeur
was out between 10 A. M. and 2 P. M. showing the new Chinese employee places
where slot-machines are installed. All together there are 53 places.

4:30 - 5 P. M. Crawley out by car alone.

5 - 9 P. M. At home.

9 P. M. Crawley and Hilda out by car.

Crawley is in a good mood and is spending most of the time with
Hilda. He is silent about his alleged departure for the North.
pages.zh:
中国上海。

(#84)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1月7日

上午9时 - 下午4时30分    克劳利待在家中。司机在上午10时至下午2时之间外出，向新来的中国雇员展示安装老虎机的地点。总共有53个地点。

下午4时30分 - 5时    克劳利独自驾车外出。

下午5时 - 9时    在家。

下午9时    克劳利与希尔达驾车外出。

克劳利心情良好，大部分时间与希尔达在一起。他对传闻中将北上之事保持沉默。

pages.en:
Shanghai - 7 - 1 - 32

(#83)
Further re Crawley
January 6th, 1932

9 - 10 a. m. Crawley alone to Seymour Road Market.
10 - 11 a. m. at home.
11 - 12:30 p. m. Crawley alone toidler's place in response
to latter's telephone call.
12:30 - 4 p. m. At home.
4 - 8 p. m. Crawley, Hilda, chauffeur and Chinese agent, who
as mentioned in yesterday's report, went to various places re slot-
machines. Crawley instructed the chauffeur to show everything concerning
slot-machines to above mentioned Chinese. Crawley himself did not leave
the car but was sitting inside kissing Hilda.
8 - 10 p. m. at home. At 8:30 p. m., idler arrived for dinner.
pages.zh:
上海 - 1932年1月7日

(#83)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1932年1月6日

上午9时至10时，克劳利独自前往西摩路市场。
上午10时至11时，在家。
上午11时至下午12时30分，克劳利应后者电话召唤，独自前往一名闲散人员（idler）的住处。
下午12时30分至4时，在家。
下午4时至8时，克劳利、希尔达（Hilda）、司机以及一名中国线人——如昨日报告所述——前往多处地点，事关老虎机事宜。克劳利指示司机向上述中国人展示有关老虎机的一切情况。克劳利本人并未下车，而是坐在车内与希尔达接吻。
晚上8时至10时，在家。晚上8时30分，该闲散人员抵达共进晚餐。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

(#82)
Further re Crawley
January 5th, 1932

9 a. m. - 4 p. m. at home.
4 - 6 p. m. A Chinese came, who some time ago was engaged by Crawley
to watch his ex-wife. They had a talk for about two hours.
6 - 8 p. m. Chauffeur was instructed to take the above mentioned
Chinese to the places where Crawley's slot machines are installed. At each
place the Chinese wrote the address in his note book. It is believed that
Crawley intends to dismiss his chauffeur and have a Chinese in control of
his slot machine business during his probable absence from Shanghai.
8 - 9 p. m. at home.
9 p. m. Crawley and Miss Hilda out.
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

(#82)
再述克劳利（Crawley）之事
1932年1月5日

上午9时至下午4时 在家。
下午4时至6时 一名华人前来，此人此前曾受克劳利雇佣，负责监视其前妻。双方交谈约两小时。
下午6时至8时 吩咐司机将上述华人带往克劳利安装老虎机（slot machines）的各处地点。每至一处，该华人便将地址记入其笔记本中。据信，克劳利打算解雇其司机，并在其可能离开上海期间，由一名华人掌管其老虎机业务。
晚上8时至9时 在家。
晚上9时 克劳利与希尔达小姐（Miss Hilda）外出。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China,

(#91)
Further re Crawley
January 4th
    9 - 11 a. m. at home.
    11 a. m. - 12:30 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur to Broadway re
slot-machines.
    12:30 - 4 p. m. at home.
    4 - 6 p. m. Crawley visited Mr. Hai, then proceeded to Great
Eastern Hotel, instructing chauffeur to go to Broadway re slot-machines.
Crawley remained at Great Eastern Hotel. Chauffeur picked him up at about
6 p. m.
    6 - 8 p. m. at home.
    8 - 9 p. m. Crawley, chauffeur and Miss Hilda re slot-machines.
Crawley left chauffeur at Black Cat to repair a slot-machine. Crawley and
Hilda proceeded to cinema.
pages.zh:
中国，上海，

(#91)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1月4日
    上午9时至11时：在家。
    上午11时至下午12时30分：克劳利与司机前往百老汇路，事关老虎机。
    下午12时30分至4时：在家。
    下午4时至6时：克劳利拜访海先生（Mr. Hai），随后前往大华饭店，指示司机前往百老汇路处理老虎机事宜。克劳利留在大华饭店。司机于下午6时左右将其接走。
    下午6时至8时：在家。
    下午8时至9时：克劳利、司机及希尔达小姐（Miss Hilda）涉及老虎机事宜。克劳利将司机留在黑猫舞厅修理一台老虎机。克劳利与希尔达前往电影院。

pages.en:
Shanghai , China.

(#80)
Further re Crawley
January 3rd, 1931
    9 a. m. - 2:30 p. m. at home.
    2:30 - 4:30 p. m. Widler came and had a private conversation with
Crawley which lasted for two hours.
    4 - 6 p. m. Crawley, Miss Hilda and Widler out.
    6 - 8 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur out re slot-machines.
    8 - 9 p. m. at home.
    9 p. m. Crawley, Miss Hilda and latter's female friend to
"Cathay Theatre".
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

(#80)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1931年1月3日
    上午9时至下午2时30分：在家。
    下午2时30分至4时30分：维德勒（Widler）来访，与克劳利进行私人谈话，历时两小时。
    下午4时至6时：克劳利、希尔达小姐（Miss Hilda）和维德勒外出。
    下午6时至8时：克劳利与司机外出，事宜涉及老虎机。
    晚上8时至9时：在家。
    晚上9时：克劳利、希尔达小姐及后者的一位女性友人前往“国泰大戏院”（Cathay Theatre）。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

(#79)
Further Re Crawley
January 2nd, 1931

9 a. m. - 2 p. m. at home.

At 2 p. m. Widlar and Ribakoff arrived and Crawley had a conversation
with them, which lasted until 4 p. m. Nature of conversation unknown.

4 - 7 p. m. Chauffeur was ordered take Crawley to Great Eastern
Hotel, himself proceeded to various places re slot-machines. Picked Crawley
up in the same place at about 7 p. m.

7 - 9 p. m. at home.

8 p. m. Crawley and Miss Hilda out.
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

(#79)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1931年1月2日

上午9时至下午2时：在家。

下午2时，威德拉尔（Widlar）和里巴科夫（Ribakoff）抵达，克劳利与他们进行了交谈，直至下午4时结束。谈话内容不详。

下午4时至7时：司机奉命将克劳利送往大华饭店（Great Eastern Hotel），随后自行前往各处处理老虎机相关事宜。约于晚上7时在同一地点接回克劳利。

晚上7时至9时：在家。

晚上8时，克劳利与希尔达小姐（Miss Hilda）外出。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

(#78)
Further re Crawley
January 1st, 1932

9 a. m. - 5 p. m. at home. Crawley was sleeping the whole day.
5 - 7 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur out re slot-machines, as there
were few urgent messages regarding slot-machines being out of order.
7 - 9 p. m. at home.
9 p. m. Crawley and Miss Hilda out by car.
------------------------------------------------------------
Miss Hilda has moved into Crawley's house.
It is reported that Crawley's wife is working in "Del Monte Cabaret".
Crawley stated that he will take his daughter to Tsingtau Convent
within a few days.
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

(#78)
再关于克劳利（Crawley）之事
1932年1月1日

上午9时至下午5时在家。克劳利整日在睡觉。
下午5时至7时，克劳利与司机外出，处理老虎机事宜，因收到数件关于老虎机故障的紧急消息。
晚上7时至9时在家。
晚上9时，克劳利与希尔达小姐（Miss Hilda）乘车外出。
------------------------------------------------------------
希尔达小姐已搬入克劳利住所。
据报，克劳利之妻在“德尔蒙特歌舞厅”（Del Monte Cabaret）工作。
克劳利称，他将于数日内将女儿送往青岛修道院（Tsingtau Convent）。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

(#77)
Further re Crawley
December 31st, 1931.
    9 a. m. - 4:30 p. m. at home.
    4:30 - 6 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur to various places re
slot-machines.
    At 6 p. m. Chauffeur left Crawley at the corner of Barry and
Avenue Road. The latter returned home by ricksha at about 7 p. m. It is
thought that Mr. Crawley called on either Mr. Hai or Widler as both live in
the same neighborhood.
    7 - 10 p. m. at home.
    10 p. m. Crawley and Miss Hilda left by car to a New Year's party.
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

(#77)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1931年12月31日。
    上午9时至下午4时30分，在家。
    下午4时30分至6时，克劳利与司机因老虎机事宜前往多处地点。
    下午6时，司机在巴里路（Barry Road）与爱文义路（Avenue Road）拐角处让克劳利下车。后者于晚上7时左右乘人力车回家。据信，克劳利先生拜访了海先生（Mr. Hai）或维德勒（Widler），因二人均居住在同一区域。
    晚上7时至10时，在家。
    晚上10时，克劳利与希尔达小姐（Miss Hilda）乘车前往参加新年聚会。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

(#76)
Further re Crawley
December 30th, 1931.
    9 a. m. - 4 p. m. at home.
    4 - 6 p. m. Chauffeur was ordered to take Crawley to
"Great Eastern Hotel" proceeded to Broadway re slot-machines and then picked
him up again.
    Returned home at 6 p. m., where found Crawley's paramour waiting.
Crawley took her out by car. Did not come back until 10 p. m.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
    Crawley's new paramour is an Eurasian woman of German origin.
Crawley calls her "Hilda".
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

(#76)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1931年12月30日。
    上午9时至下午4时——在家。
    下午4时至6时——奉命派司机送克劳利前往
“汇中饭店”（Great Eastern Hotel），随后前往百老汇路查看老虎机事宜，之后再次将其接回。
    下午6时返回家中，发现克劳利的情妇正在等候。
克劳利驾车带其外出。直至晚上10时才回来。
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
    克劳利的新情妇是一名德裔欧亚混血女子。
克劳利称她为“希尔达”（Hilda）。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

December 29th, 1931

(#75)
Further re Crawley

3 a. m. - 3 p. m. at home. Sleeping after stepping out
on December 28th.

3 - 5:30 p. m/ Crawley and his paramour out.

5:30 - 8 p. m. at home.

8 - 9 p. m. Crawley out alone.

9 - 10:30 p. m. At home. At about 9 p. m. Fidler arrived in
company with an unknown Chinese. All three had a conversation in the
dining room, but Crawley's paramour has been sent to bedroom.
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

1931年12月29日

(#75)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告

凌晨3点至下午3点：在家。因12月28日外出，正在补觉。

下午3点至5点30分：克劳利与其情妇外出。

下午5点30分至8点：在家。

晚上8点至9点：克劳利独自外出。

晚上9点至10点30分：在家。约晚上9时，菲德勒（Fidler）与一名身份不明的华人一同抵达。三人在餐厅交谈，但克劳利的情妇已被遣往卧室。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

(#74)
Further re Crawley
December 28th, 1931

8 a. m. - 3p. m. at home.
3 - 6 p. m. to E.idler's house
6 - 8 p. m. at home.
8 p. m. out with his new sweetheart. (Reported returned home
at 3 a. m. on 29th inst.
------------------------------------------------------------
Crawley is not so nervous as he was recently and most of his
time is spent in the company of his new sweetheart. He is silent regarding his
proposed departure from Shanghai.
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

(#74)
再述克劳利（Crawley）之事
1931年12月28日

上午8时至下午3时在家。
下午3时至6时前往艾德勒（E.idler）寓所
下午6时至8时在家。
晚上8时与其新欢外出。（据报于本月29日凌晨3时返家。）
------------------------------------------------------------
克劳利（Crawley）不像近期那样神经紧张，大部分时间都与其新欢在一起。对于拟议中的离开上海一事，他缄口不言。

pages.en:
Shanghai - 23 - 12 - 31.

(#72,
further re Crawley
December 26th
9 a. m. - 3:30 p. m. at home.
3:30 - 4 p. m. to Telegraph office, where-from Crawley sent
a wire to U S. A. Contents of wire unknown but think it was sent to
Mills Slot Machine Company, as Crawley mentioned something about a letter
which he re received from Mills.
4 - 5 p. m. at home.
5 - 5:30 p. m. Crawley out alone.
5:30 p. m. - 9 p. m. at home.
9 p. m. - 3 a. m. (27-12-31) Crawley out with his new sweetheart.
pages.zh:
上海 - 31 - 12 - 23。

（第72号，
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
12月26日
上午9时至下午3时30分：在家。
下午3时30分至4时：前往电报局，克劳利从该处向美国发送了一份电报。电报内容不详，但认为系发往米尔斯老虎机公司（Mills Slot Machine Company），因克劳利曾提及他收到米尔斯公司来信一事。
下午4时至5时：在家。
下午5时至5时30分：克劳利独自外出。
下午5时30分至晚上9时：在家。
晚上9时至凌晨3时（31年12月27日）：克劳利与其新欢外出。

pages.en:
Shanghai, China.

(73)
Further re Crawley
December 27th,
    3 a. m. - 5 . m. at home.
    5 - 6 p. m. Crawley out alone.
    6 - 9 p. m. at home at about 8 p. m. a Chinese named Mr. Hai
(residing at Ferry Road) arrived. They both departed by Crawley's car at
9 p. m.
------------------------------------------------------------
   idler has not visited Crawley during the holidays, but telephoned
him several times. The conversation has been very short - Crawley saying
"No, no news" or "Nothing yet".
    Crawley silent about his proposed departure to Tsingtau and
Harbin.
pages.zh:
中国，上海。

(73)
再述克劳利（Crawley）之事
12月27日，
    凌晨3点至下午5点：在家。
    下午5点至6点：克劳利独自外出。
    下午6点至9点：在家。约晚上8时，一位姓海的中国男子（居住于斐伦路）到访。两人于晚上9时乘克劳利的汽车离开。
------------------------------------------------------------
   艾德勒（idler）在假期期间未拜访克劳利，但曾数次致电给他。通话内容非常简短——克劳利称“不，没有消息”或“尚无动静”。
    克劳利对其拟议前往青岛和哈尔滨之行缄口不言。

pages.en:
S anghai - 26 - 12 - 31

(490)
Further re Crawley
Dec. 24th
9 - 11 a. m. at home.
11 a. m. - 1 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur to Broadway re slot
machines.
1 - 4 p. m. at home.
4 - 6 p. m. Crawley, his children shopping.
6 - 7 p. m. Chauffeur was sent out re slot-machines.
7 p. m. - a lady arrived and Crawley dressed for dinner and
departed with her.
------------------------------------------------------------
pages.zh:
上海 - 31年12月26日

(490)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
12月24日
上午9时至11时：在家。
上午11时至下午1时：克劳利与司机前往百老汇路，事关老虎机。
下午1时至4时：在家。

下午6时至7时：司机被派出，事关老虎机。

Shanghai

Further Re Crawley
December 25th, 1931.

9 a m. - 3 p. m. At home. Widler arrived at 12 noon and remained

3 - 4 p. m. Crawley took his guests to their respective homes
and returned home.
4 - 4:30 p. m. At home.
4:30 - 5 p. m. Crawley out, alone.
5 - 9 p. m. At home.

The lady mentioned above probably is new deputy of Mrs.
Crawley. She is of Eurasian origin.

上海

关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
1931年12月25日。

上午9时至下午3时 - 在家。维德勒（Widler）于中午12时抵达，并留下共进午餐。除维德勒外，还有一位女士，她在前一晚曾与克劳利外出，且很可能在克劳利家中过夜。
下午3时至4时 - 克劳利将客人送至各自住处后返家。
下午4时至4时30分 - 在家。
下午4时30分至5时 - 克劳利独自外出。
下午5时至9时 - 在家。

上述女士很可能是克劳利夫人的新替身（或新欢）。她具有欧亚混血血统。

Shanghai - 24 - 12 - 31

(#69)
Further re Crawley
December 23rd
    9 a. m. - 1.50 p. m. at home together with Mr. E.idler,
who came early.
    1:50 - 4 p. m. at home with two Chinese agents, who are follow-
ing his wife. Crawley questioned them and typed it down, as it looked like
he was taking statement from them.
    4 - 7 p. m. at Great Eastern Hotel. Chauffeur was waiting out-
side. Crawley came down evidently under influence of opium or cocaine.
    7 - 8 p. m. at home. Sidler present.

上海 - 31 - 12 - 24

(#69)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
12月23日
    上午9时至下午1时50分，在家中与早到的艾德勒（E.idler）先生在一起。
    下午1时50分至4时，在家中与两名跟踪其妻子的华探在一起。克劳利向他们问话并打字记录，看起来像是在录取他们的口供。
    下午4时至7时，在大东旅馆（Great Eastern Hotel）。司机在外面等候。克劳利下楼时，显然处于鸦片或可卡因的影响之下。
    下午7时至8时，在家中。西德勒（Sidler）在场。

At 11 a. m. Crawley instructed the chauffeur to take him to
Maj. Holcomb's office and sent him re slot-machines.
At 12:30 p. m. chauffeur returned for Crawley and found the
later waiting for car together with Mr. E. Sidler. All three went to

12:30 - 4 P. M. at home.
4 - 7 p. m. with children shopping.
7 - 10 p. m. at home. Sidler spent whole evening in Crawley's

上海 - 31 - 12 - 23

下午4时至7时，携子女购物。

December 21st,
9 a. m. - 4 p. m. at home.
4 to 6 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur down town. Crawley left car
at Maj. Holcomb's office. At 6 p. m. motor car picked him up at the corner

6 - 9 p. m. at home.

The whole morning and part of the afternoon on 21st inst., Crawley

No preparations for departure noticed and Crawley is silent about it.

12月21日）
上海 - 31年12月22日
(#67)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
12月21日，
上午9时至下午4时在家。
下午4时至6时，克劳利与司机前往市区。克劳利将车留在霍尔科姆（Holcomb）少校的办公室。下午6时，汽车在四川路与江西路路口、舒尔（Schuhl）先生办公室的台阶处接他。
晚上6时至9时在家。

本月21日上午及下午部分时间，克劳利一直在打字处理某些文件，结束后烧毁了一些纸张和文件。

未观察到有离境准备，且克劳利对此保持沉默。

C.B.

(#66)
Further re Crawley

December 20th

8 a. m. - 12 noon - At home.
12 noon - 1:30 p. m. - Out re slot-machines.
1:30 - 2 p. m. at home.
2 - 3 p. m. Crawley out by car alone.
3 - 5 p. m. at home.
5 - 5:30 Crawley walked out. (Has been seen walking alone
on Avenue Joffre.)
5:30 - 9 p. m. at home.
9 p. m. - 12 midnight Crawley and daughter out to Theatre.

------------------------------------------------------------

Crawley's Russian Secretary has been dismissed from last Saturday.
Evidently for refusal to be his mistress.

Crawley had a talk with us on Sunday regarding his ex-wife. He
expressed regret that he lost her as she was very obedient and economical.
However, he said that she became a prostitute now and Saturday night spent
at Hotel Plaza with the man.
pages.zh:
艾恩斯沃思先生
C.B.

上海 - 31年12月21日

(#66)
续报克劳利情况

12月20日

上午8时至中午12时 - 在家。
中午12时至下午1时30分 - 外出，处理老虎机事宜。
下午1时30分至2时 - 在家。
下午2时至3时 - 克劳利独自乘车外出。
下午3时至5时 - 在家。
下午5时至5时30分 - 克劳利步行外出。（有人看见他独自在霞飞路行走。）
下午5时30分至9时 - 在家。
晚上9时至午夜12时 - 克劳利与女儿外出看戏。

------------------------------------------------------------

克劳利的俄国秘书已于上周六被解雇。
显然是因为拒绝做他的情妇。

克劳利于周日与我们谈及其前妻。他表示遗憾失去了她，因为她非常顺从且节俭。然而，他说她现在已沦为妓女，周六晚上与该男子在华懋饭店度过。

pages.en:
（批：Mr Ames / Mr C.P.）
Shanghai - 19 - 12 - 31

(#68)
Further re Crawley
December 18th

9 a. m. - 2 p. m. at home.

2 - 7 p. m. Crawley down town alone. It is, however, known
that between 2 -3 p. m. he was walking outside Mr. Schuhl's office and
entered in about 3 p. m.

7 - 9 p. m. at home.

9 - 11:30 p. m. Crawley took his daughter to "Capital Theatre".

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Lately during the day Crawley receives a very strange telephone
message. He simply takes off the receiver, listens and answers, "Yes",
or "O. K.", or something similar, but always short and then puts receiver
back.

We tried best to answer the call, but it always happens, that
Crawley is at home.

The times for the calls are not regular.

It seems to be somebody reporting something to Crawley.
pages.zh:
（批注：艾姆斯先生 / C.P. 先生）
上海 - 19 - 12 - 31

(#68)
再关于克劳利（Crawley）之事
12月18日

上午9时至下午2时——在家。

下午2时至7时——克劳利独自前往市区。然而，据知在下午2时至3时之间，他曾在舒尔（Schuhl）先生的办公室外行走，并于下午3时左右进入该处。

晚上7时至9时——在家。

晚上9时至11时30分——克劳利带其女儿前往“大光明大戏院”（Capital Theatre）。

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

近日白天，克劳利接到一通非常奇怪的电话。他只是拿起听筒，聆听并回答“是”、“好的”或类似的话语，但总是简短应答，随后便挂断电话。

我们曾尽力尝试接听该来电，但情况总是如此，即克劳利当时在家。

来电时间并不固定。

这似乎是有人在向克劳利汇报某些事情。

pages.en:
Shanghai - 18 - 12 - 31

(批：Mr. Ames / Mr. Ols)
(#65)
Further re Crawley
December 17th

9 - 11 a. m. at home.

At 11 a. m. Crawley drove away, alone and returned at 11:30
a. m. with a Chinese visitor, who is absolutely unknown. Crawley had a
conversation with the said Chinese for about an hour and took all pre-
cautions not to be overheard.

1 p. m. Crawley and above mentioned Chinese visitor out by
former's car.

5 p. m. Crawley back, alone.

5 - 6 p. m. at home.

6 - 8 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur out re slot machines.

8 - 9 p. m. at home.

------------------------------------------------------------

Mrs. Crawley had a meeting this afternoon with Mr. Crawley in
Mr. Sekuhl's office.
pages.zh:
上海 - 31 - 12 - 18

（批注：艾姆斯先生 / 奥尔森先生）
(#65)
关于克劳利之进一步报告
12月17日

上午9时至11时，在家。

上午11时，克劳利独自驾车外出，于上午11时30分返回，带回一名完全陌生的中国访客。克劳利与该中国人交谈约一小时，并采取一切预防措施以防被窃听。

下午1时，克劳利与上述中国访客乘坐前者汽车外出。

下午5时，克劳利独自返回。

下午5时至6时，在家。

下午6时至8时，克劳利与司机外出，事宜涉及老虎机。

晚上8时至9时，在家。

------------------------------------------------------------

克劳利夫人今天下午在塞库尔先生的办公室与克劳利先生会面。

pages.en:
Mr Ains
C.I.D.
Shanghai - 17 - 12 - 31

(#64)
Further re Crawley
December 16th, 1931

9 - 11 a. m. at home.
11 a. m. - 12:30 p. m. to Great Eastern Hotel. As usual while
Chauffeur was working with the slot-machine, Crawley went upstairs "to
see friends".
12:30 - 6 p. m. at home.
6 - 7 p. m. Crawley out alone.
7 - 9 p. m. at home.

Crawley stated that he will leave for North during the coming
holidays. He said that the main purpose of his trip is to take his daughter
to Tsingtao Convent.

Nothing was heard from Mrs. Crawley during the last two days.
pages.zh:
艾恩斯先生 (Mr Ains)
刑事侦缉处 (C.I.D.)
上海 - 31年12月17日

(#64)
关于克劳利 (Crawley) 的进一步报告
1931年12月16日

上午9时至11时：在家。
上午11时至下午12时30分：前往大华饭店 (Great Eastern Hotel)。照例，当司机在操作老虎机时，克劳利上楼“去见朋友”。
下午12时30分至6时：在家。
下午6时至7时：克劳利独自外出。
下午7时至9时：在家。

克劳利称，他将在即将到来的假期期间前往北方。他说，此行的主要目的是送他的女儿去青岛修道院 (Tsingtao Convent)。

过去两天里没有收到克劳利夫人的任何消息。

pages.en:
（批：Ann
Mr. C D.）

Shanghai - 16 - 12 - 31.

(#63)

Further re Crawley

December 15th

It was a very quiet day in Crawley's life. From 9 a. m. to
6 p. m. he remained at home together with a Chinese Bookkeeper preparing
accounts for Mills & Co., re slot-machine business.
6 - 7:30 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur out to Broadway re slot-
machines.
7:30 - 8 p. m. at home.
8 - 9 p. m. Crawley out alone.
----------------------------------------
Crawley is in a very bad mood lately and spending most nights
smoking opium.
Mrs. Crawley still staying at 135 Route Say Zoong.
pages.zh:
（批注：安 (Ann)
C. D. 先生）

上海 - 31年12月16日

(#63)

关于克劳利的进一步报告

12月15日

这是克劳利生活中非常平静的一天。从上午9时至下午6时，他与一名正在为米尔斯公司 (Mills & Co.) 准备有关老虎机业务账目的中国簿记员一起待在家里。
下午6时至7时30分：克劳利和司机前往百老汇路 (Broadway) 处理老虎机事宜。
下午7时30分至8时：在家。
下午8时至9时：克劳利独自外出。
----------------------------------------
克劳利最近情绪非常糟糕，大部分夜晚都在吸食鸦片。
克劳利夫人仍住在赛宗路 (Route Say Zoong) 135号。

pages.en:
Shanghai - 14 - 12 - 31

(#60)
Further re Crawley
Saturday, December 12th
At home until 11 a. m.
11 a. m. - 12:30 p. m. Crawley out alone.
12:30 - 3 p. m. at home.
3 - 6 p. m. Crawley out alone. Mentioned that he is going to
see Maj. Holcomb and Mr. Schuhl.
6 - 8 p. m. at home.
pages.zh:
上海 - 31年12月14日

(#60)
关于克劳利的进一步报告
12月12日，星期六
上午11时前在家。
上午11时至下午12时30分：克劳利独自外出。
下午12时30分至3时：在家。
下午3时至6时：克劳利独自外出。提到他要去看霍尔科姆少校 (Maj. Holcomb) 和舒尔先生 (Mr. Schuhl)。
下午6时至8时：在家。

pages.en:
Shanghai - 15 - 12 - 31

(#62)
Further re Crawley
December 14th

9 - 11 a. m. at home

11 - 12:30 Crawley out alone. Before leaving said that he
must see Holcomb and Schuhl.

12:30 - 3 p. m. at home.

3 - 5 p. m. Crawley out alone to visit a French Police Inspector,
who is in charge of a Police Station on Avenue Joffre, opposite Route Say
Zoong. The latter is a friend of Crawley and always helping when Crawley is
in trouble.

5 - 6 p. m. at home.

6 - 8:30 p. m. Crawley out alone in response of a telephone call.
The conversation was very brief and Crawley only said "Hello" and "I will
be right there". Crawley himself answered the phone, so chauffeur does
not know who was calling.

------------------------------------------------------------

Chauffeur is in panic as Mrs. Crawley has started to blackmail
him demanding a new dress and saying that if he fails she will telephone
to Crawley and will tell all about their relations. Chauffeur thinks that
Crawley suspected that there was something improper between the chauffeur
and her, but he was never sure and if she will tell him, chauffeur is
afraid he might be bitten, if not killed.
pages.zh:
上海 - 31年12月15日

(#62)
关于克劳利的进一步报告
12月14日

上午9时至11时：在家

上午11时至12时30分：克劳利独自外出。离开前说必须去见霍尔科姆 (Holcomb) 和舒尔 (Schuhl)。

下午12时30分至3时：在家。

下午3时至5时：克劳利独自外出拜访一位法国巡捕房督察，该督察负责霞飞路 (Avenue Joffre) 上赛宗路 (Route Say Zoong) 对面的一个巡捕房。此人是克劳利的朋友，在克劳利遇到麻烦时总是提供帮助。

下午5时至6时：在家。

下午6时至8时30分：克劳利因接到一个电话而独自外出。谈话非常简短，克劳利只说了“你好”和“我马上就到”。克劳利亲自接的电话，所以司机不知道是谁打来的。

------------------------------------------------------------

司机感到恐慌，因为克劳利夫人开始敲诈他，索要一件新衣服，并说如果他不能满足要求，她就会给克劳利打电话，把他们之间的关系全部抖落出来。司机认为克劳利怀疑他和她之间有不正当关系，但克劳利从未确定过；如果她告诉克劳利，司机担心自己可能会挨打，甚至被杀。

pages.en:
(#61)
Further re Crawley
Sunday, December 13th
9 - 10 a. m. Crawley out alone.
10 a. m. - 2:30 p. m. at home.
2:30 - 5:30 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur to Bubbling Well Road re
slot-machines and then to Great Eastern Hotel , where Crawley proceeded up-
stairs and stayed there a considerable time.
5.30 - 6 p. m. at home.
6 p. m. - 8:30 p. m. at home.
------------------------------------------------------------
Crawley is still watching his ex-wife. Chinese agents are re-
porting her movements to him daily.
pages.zh:
(#61)
关于克劳利的进一步报告
12月13日，星期日
上午9时至10时：克劳利独自外出。
上午10时至下午2时30分：在家。
下午2时30分至5时30分：克劳利和司机前往静安寺路 (Bubbling Well Road) 处理老虎机事宜，随后前往大华饭店 (Great Eastern Hotel)，克劳利上楼并在那里停留了相当长的一段时间。
下午5时30分至6时：在家。
下午6时至8时30分：在家。
------------------------------------------------------------
克劳利仍在监视他的前妻。中国线人每天向他报告她的行踪。

The Circus
Maj. C.I.D.

Shanghai - 12 - 12 - 31

December 11th

9 - 11 a. m. at home

At 11 a. m. chauffeur brought Crawley to Maj. Holcomb's office,
himself attended few slot-machines and called for Crawley at Holcomb's at
1 p. m.

1 - 3 p. m. at home

3 - 5:30 p. m. Crawley out, alone.

5:30 - 8 p. m. at home.

------------------------------------------------------------

Mrs. Crawley has removed to No. 135 Route Say Zoong, which is
reported to be a Russian Boarding house, owned by Mr. Raskin.

S. C. Crowden of the C. I. D. has signed as surety on an appli-

上午11时，司机将克劳利送到霍尔科姆少校 (Maj. Holcomb) 的办公室，司机自己去照看几台老虎机，并于下午1时在霍尔科姆处接回克劳利。
