刑事侦缉处的 S. C. 克劳登 (S. C. Crowden) 为一名叫普尔 (Poole) 的警员向中国金融公司 (China Finance Corporation) 申请贷款签署了担保书。据报道，他仍与露西·克劳利 (Lucy Crawley) 保持联系。

pages.en:
Mr. Aires
el p.
(#58)
Shanghai - 11 - 12 - 31
Further re Crawley
December 10th
10:30 a. m. - 1:30 p. m. Crawley out alone. Between 11 and
12 noon he spent in Velvet Cafe, where he had a meeting with Mr. V. A.
Ribakoff. On leaving the house he also said that he intended meeting
his ex-wife, but on return did not mention anything about proposed meeting.
1:30 - 4:30 at home.
4:30 - 5:00 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur to Garage re repairing
the car.
5 - 3:30 p. m. at home.
Crawley states that he formally separated from his wife without
any claims from her side. He said that he knew she was living with a
British detective and slept with the latter in one of the boarding houses
on Route Vallon. Lately she visited another man in Plaza Hotel.
Crawley also stated that he and Widler had a misunderstanding
on account of a certain debt.
Crawley dismissed his housekeeper on 10th inst. The cause is
she was an obstruction to his intentions regarding his secretary Miss
Amelina. It seems that Crawley wishes to seduce her but afraid on account
(3) of the fact that she is under age (17 years) and has parents in Shanghai,
who can defend her.

关于克劳利的进一步报告
12月10日
上午10时30分至下午1时30分：克劳利独自外出。中午11时至12时期间，他在天鹅绒咖啡馆 (Velvet Cafe) 度过，并与 V. A. 里巴科夫先生 (Mr. V. A. Ribakoff) 会面。离开住所时，他还表示打算去见他的前妻，但回来后并未提及任何关于拟议会面的情况。
下午1时30分至4时30分：在家。
下午4时30分至5时：克劳利和司机前往车库修车。
下午5时至3时30分：在家。（注：原文时间顺序有误，照实译出）
克劳利声称，他与妻子正式分居，且女方未提出任何索赔要求。他说他知道她正与一名英国侦探同居，并在瓦伦路 (Route Vallon) 的一处寄宿公寓中与后者同宿。最近她还去华懋公寓 (Plaza Hotel) 探望了另一名男子。
克劳利还称，他和维德勒 (Widler) 因某笔债务产生了误会。
克劳利于本月10日解雇了他的女管家。原因是她阻碍了他对其秘书阿梅琳娜小姐 (Miss Amelina) 的意图。看来克劳利希望引诱她，但因她未成年（17岁）且父母在上海可以保护她而感到顾虑。

December 7th
9 a. m. - 3:30 p. m. Crawley was staying home.
3:30 - 5:30 p. m. Crawley out alone.
5:30 - 9:30 p. m. at home.
Mrs. Crawley claims that police promised to give her a job.
She stated that she has been informed by the police that Crawley is
seeking a chance to kill her, but that she is under police protection.
Widler has not shown up for last three days.
Crawley does not show that he knows about J. S. S. Henderson's
presence in Shanghai.
Re - Widler, Ribakoff and Bisberg
1/ E. Widler's new address is No. 136 Seymour Road, Apt. No. 7, as was
stated in report dated 3 / 12 / 31. Inquiries are proceeding for the
purpose of ascertaining who else is living in this apartment.
11/ V. A. Ribakoff has been located at No. 421 Rue Cardinal Mercier, accord-
ing to a name card which is attached herewith he has slightly changed
spelling of his name, using Rebikoff, instead of Ribakoff, but it is
the same person who was charged recently for the unlawful buying of stolen
pistols from American Marine. After the case he left Shanghai and spent
few months in Hankden and returned to Shanghai recently. Ribakoff is the
same person, who together with E. Widler visited Crawley's house on
November 30th. Ribakoff's official business is manufacture and sale of
bullet-proof-waist-coats, but really he is a notorious arms-dealer.

她说，警方通知她，克劳利正在寻找杀害她的机会，但她受到警方的保护。
维德勒 (Widler) 已经三天没有露面。
克劳利没有表现出他知道 J. S. S. 亨德森 (J. S. S. Henderson) 在上海的消息。
关于维德勒、里巴科夫和比斯伯格 (Bisberg)
1/ E. 维德勒的新地址是西摩路 (Seymour Road) 136号7室，如31年12月3日的报告所述。正在进行调查，以确定还有谁住在这套公寓里。
11/ V. A. 里巴科夫已被定位在梅神父路 (Rue Cardinal Mercier) 421号，根据随附的名片，他稍微改变了名字的拼写，使用 Rebikoff 而不是 Ribakoff，但这正是最近因从美国海军陆战队士兵非法购买被盗手枪而被指控的同一个人。案件结束后他离开了上海，在汉口 (Hankden) 待了几个月，最近回到上海。里巴科夫就是11月30日与 E. 维德勒一起拜访克劳利住宅的那个人。里巴科夫的公开职业是制造和销售防弹背心，但实际上他是一个臭名昭著的军火商。

III/ Mr. Ponamareff, Superintendent of Park Apartments has been interviewed
and states that there is no tenant, named Bisberg residing at Park

Further re Crawley

Dec. 4th

9 a. m. - 12 noon at home.

2 - 3 p. m. at home.

3 - 4:30 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur to Great Eastern Hotel.
Chauffeur was waiting in the car while Crawley went up-stairs.

4:30 - 5 p. m. at home.

Crawley stated that he hired two Chinese detectives to watch
his ex-wife for the purpose of proving that she is not faithful to him and
thus avoid the payment of money, which she is demanding. However, it is
believed that was done for the purpose of tracing her movements, as
Crawley is afraid she is talking too much.

Crawley also stated that he could not go to Harbin unless he
settles with Mrs. Crawley.

He did not hear from Ah Li since the beginning of November, when
Crawley stated that A. Li left for Soochow. Crawley has not gone to
Kungping Road since, but some time visited Velvet Cafe, where he has a
slot-machine and it is believed receives his mail.

Crawley is silent about U. S. S. "Henderson", but we have our
eyes and ears open and will report immediately if anything happens.

Crawley andidler are constantly talking about Mrs. Crawley;
that she betrayed him or intends to betray him; the indications are that

克劳利称，他雇佣了两名中国侦探监视他的前妻，目的是证明她对他不忠，从而避免支付她所要求的钱款。然而，人们认为这样做是为了追踪她的行踪，因为克劳利担心她话太多。

克劳利还表示，除非他与克劳利夫人达成和解，否则他无法去哈尔滨。

Los Angeles.
Donley. Broadcasting Association.

San Francisco.
Joe Varton.

Chicago.
Varton. Formerly Borolesnikoff.

1931年12月8日。

关于克劳利（P.S. Crawley）的进一步情况。
关系网。
据称维德勒（Vidler）在西摩路136号开设了一个轮盘赌局。据说家具由 C 于1931年12月2日提供。
C 和 W 于1931年11月30日访问了 H.O.T.。儿子后来无意中听到他们讨论未来经由日内瓦向 H.O.T. 供应高射炮和1000支汤普森冲锋枪的事宜。
里斯伯格（Risberg）将从日内瓦来到上海。他的妻子一直在拉斐特路455号龙园公寓（Lone Park Apartments）与 W 举行会议。该地址与劳伯特夫妇（Laubberts）的住址相同。
肖特（Short），前海军陆战队员。持有一批手枪，雷比科夫（Rebiekoff）、W 和 C 未能于1931年11月26日提取这批货物。

洛杉矶。
唐利（Donley）。广播协会。
关系网的范围不详。

旧金山。
乔·瓦顿（Joe Varton）。

芝加哥。
瓦顿（Varton）。原名博罗莱斯尼科夫（Borolesnikoff）。
在1917/18年间曾与 C 做过一些金日元交易，目前仍有联系。C 像给旧金山的肖特先生一样，给他寄送剪报。

瓦顿。“左派”。加利福尼亚州。

可能是同一个人，但未经证实。

移民局（I.N.S.）表示，他们在1931年7月下旬和8月上旬收到的任何笔记都可以由他们清点

pages.en:
- 2 -

Information.

Widler calls frequently on L.J.I. and tries to get
her to sign a deed of separation. This is said to
have been already signed by P.S. and Mjr. H. Said
to contain a special clause reference "silence in
all business matters". They are in haste to get
it signed before the 5th (?).

C's Russian mechanic met L.J.I. and advised her not
to go to Mjr. H to a proposed meeting on December 2
at 4-5 p.m. as a plot had been arranged to have her
prosecuted at Shanghai Special District Court on a
charge of using his name etc.. She did not go.

C told the children the day before, that their mother
(L.J.I.) had "done him dirty" but "never mind, the
devil is behind us". One copy of agreement was
marked "for U.S. Consular record office".

C's trip to Tsingtao.

Ticket for passage was never taken but C told L.J.I.
that she could attend to say "goodbye" to child.
"Bay" overheard C and W talking of "Kissing her off"
on the day before due to sail, so warned her, and she
did not go. Boat "Ajum" Maru. 29-11-31.

C has an Oakland car at Bill's motors, License 1598 ,
which is being repainted Black for use of W.

Ford No.6477 & 12 slot machines are mortgaged to □□□□□□□□
Finance Corporation by L.J.I. who was compelled to give
a deed of sale to C. This was bluff on his part in case
of trouble.

W was overheard phoning to Mrs. Te□ for his sister.
Said "Telfer must get a certain cable" and she was the
only one who could arrange it. Telfer is said to be
a cable company employee.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

情报。

维德勒频繁拜访 L.J.I.，并试图让她签署一份分居契约。据说 P.S. 和 H 少校（Mjr. H.）已经签署了该文件。据说其中包含一个特别条款，提及“在所有商业事务中保持沉默”。他们急于在5日（？）之前让其签署。

C 的俄罗斯机械师会见了 L.J.I.，并建议她不要参加原定于12月2日下午4点至5点与 H 少校的会面，因为有人策划在上海特区法院以冒用其名义等罪名起诉她。她没有去。

C 前一天告诉孩子们，他们的母亲（L.J.I.）“对他不仁”，但“没关系，魔鬼在我们身后”。其中一份协议副本上标记为“供美国领事馆档案室存档”。

C 的青岛之行。

从未购买船票，但 C 告诉 L.J.I.，她可以去向孩子说“再见”。“贝”（Bay）在前一天无意中听到 C 和 W 谈论在预定启航日前一天“把她打发走”，于是警告了她，她没有去。船只：“阿珠丸”（Ajum Maru）。1931年11月29日。

C 在比尔汽车行（Bill's motors）有一辆奥克兰牌汽车，牌照号1598，目前正在重新漆成黑色供 W 使用。

福特汽车第6477号及12台老虎机被 L.J.I. 抵押给 □□□□□□□□ 金融公司，她被迫向 C 出具了一份卖契。这是他在遇到麻烦时使用的虚张声势的手段。

无意中听到 W 打电话给 Te□ 太太找他的妹妹。他说“特尔弗（Telfer）必须拿到某份电报”，而她是唯一能安排此事的人。据说特尔弗是电报公司的雇员。

pages.en:
- 3 -

W said to be arranging a trip with C to Hankow where
the situation is said to be propitious for opening
a gambling den.

C was at No.4 Ferry Road a week ago (Own operator
report). Occupant Zih Kung Sung was connected with
General Sun Chuan Fong a year ago as adviser.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

据说 W 正与 C 安排前往汉口的行程，据说那里的形势有利于开设赌场。

C 一周前曾在斐伦路2号（No.2 Ferry Road）出现（本处探员报告）。住户恣公松（Zih Kung Sung，音译）一年前曾作为顾问与孙传芳将军有联系。

pages.en:
McGinness
CIB

Shanghai - 4 - 12 - 31.

(# 51)

Further re. Crawley

Dec. 3rd

9:00 a. m. - 12 noon at home.idler came at 9:30 a. m.
- 3 p. m. Crawley down-town alone.
- 5 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur to Broadway re slot-machines.
On their way back home they visited Great Eastern Hotel. Crawley went
up-stairs to see somebody.
- 6 p. m. at home.

There was nothing shown by Crawley that he knew about
"Vanderecn's" arrival here yesterday. He is silent also about proposed
trip to Harbin. So far as we understand Crawley and idler are mostly
discussing Mrs. Crawley, planning to do something to stop her talking.
We managed to see Mrs. Crawley on 3rd inst., for ten minutes,
but she could not say anything interesting and on contrary asked for an
account of Crawley's doings.
pages.zh:
麦金尼斯（McGinness）
刑事侦缉处（CIB）

上海 - 1931年12月4日。

(# 51)

关于克劳利的进一步情况

12月3日

上午9:00 - 中午12:00 在家。维德勒于上午9:30到来。
- 下午3:00 克劳利独自前往市区。
- 下午5:00 克劳利和司机前往百老汇路处理老虎机事宜。
在回家的路上，他们访问了汇中饭店（Great Eastern Hotel）。克劳利上楼去见某人。
- 下午6:00 在家。

克劳利没有任何迹象表明他知道“范德肯”（Vanderecn，音译）昨天抵达此处。他对提议的哈尔滨之行也保持沉默。据我们了解，克劳利和维德勒主要在讨论克劳利夫人，计划采取措施阻止她说话。我们在本月3日设法见到了克劳利夫人十分钟，但她没说出什么有趣的内容，反而询问克劳利的行踪。

pages.en:
（批：Mr. Ames 8/5）
Shanghai - 3 - 12 - 31.

(#50)
Further re Crawley
No. 2nd

9 - 11 a. m. at home.
11 a. m. - 1 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur to Naval Credit Co.
(Russian pawnshop) on Avenue Joffre, then to Broadway re slot-machines.
1 - 2:30 p. m. at home.
2:30 - 6 p. m. Crawley to Great Eastern Hotel and up-stairs
"to see friend". Chauffeur left Crawley at Maj. Holcomb's office and
himself proceeded to Hongkew District re slot-machines. Returned to
Holcomb's office and picked up Crawley at 4.30 p. m. From 5:00 to 6:00
p. m. Crawley visitedidler in the later's new address No. 136 Seymour
Road, Apt. 7.
6 - 6:15 p. m. at home.
Crawley upon his return at 7:30 P. M. received a telephone
message, ordered car from garage and proceeded to some unknown place.
Crawley accompanied by idler returned home at about 8 p. m.

------------------------------------------------------------
In the evening of 2nd inst. Crawley did telephone his ex-
wife and asked her to appoint time and place for a meeting "to talk things
over", but she refused to meet him.
idler visited Mrs. Crawley on 1st inst., and asked her to sign
certain papers, which are supposed to have been prepared by Maj. Holcomb.
She refused.
Crawley said that he will sue his ex-wife in Chinese Court as she
is talking too much. This indicates that Crawley has a source of information
regarding her activity and intentions.
pages.zh:
（批注：Ames 先生 5/8）
上海 - 1931年12月3日。

(#50)
关于克劳利的进一步情况
2日

上午9 - 11点 在家。
上午11点 - 下午1点 克劳利和司机前往霞飞路上的海军信贷公司（Russian pawnshop，俄当铺），随后前往百老汇路处理老虎机事宜。
下午1 - 2:30 在家。
下午2:30 - 6:00 克劳利前往汇中饭店并上楼“会见朋友”。司机将克劳利留在霍尔科姆少校（Maj. Holcomb）的办公室，自己前往虹口区处理老虎机事宜。下午4:30返回霍尔科姆的办公室接克劳利。下午5:00至6:00，克劳利在维德勒的新址西摩路136号7室拜访了维德勒。
下午6 - 6:15 在家。
克劳利于晚上7:30返回后收到电话留言，从车库叫了车并前往某个未知地点。
克劳利在维德勒的陪同下于晚上8点左右回家。

------------------------------------------------------------
本月2日晚，克劳利确实给他的前妻打了电话，要求她约定时间和地点见面“商量事情”，但她拒绝见他。
维德勒于本月1日拜访了克劳利夫人，并要求她签署某些文件，据称这些文件是由霍尔科姆少校准备的。她拒绝了。
克劳利表示，他将在中国法院起诉他的前妻，因为她话太多。这表明克劳利有关于她活动和意图的情报来源。

pages.en:
（批：Mr Ames
a.p.
(#49)）

Shanghai - 2 - 12 -31

Further re Crawley

Dec. 1

Between 11:00 a. m. and 12 noon Crawley, Widler and chauffeur
went to various places re slot-machines.

Between 12 noon and 2:30 P. M. at home

Between 2:30 and 3:30 P. M. Widler went somewhere in Crawley's
car. Crawley walked aimlessly around Verdun Terrace.

Between 3:30 and 5:30 Crawley and Widler went down town. Crawley
overheard 'phoning to Maj. Holcomb and asking if he can see later between
4 and 5 p. m.

5:30 - 8:30 P. M. at home. Widler also in.

The house, where Mrs. Crawley is residing at present is now
watched by Chinese Private Detectives, hired by Crawley. The watch started
from tiffin time on 1st inst.

The exact location of A. Li's residence is not known at present.
Li goes from his office on Kung Ping Road to the passage J. e. 778 Tongshang
Road. There are about 100 houses inside of the above mentioned alleyway and
naturally we could not locate Li's house. However, Li has a mole on his
chin with long hairs growing on it and any Chinese agent sent to this alley-
way could locate him at any time. We have, therefore, detailed an assistant
to Li's place of business with instructions to locate exact place of resi-
dence by Wednesday at 12 M.
pages.zh:
（批注：Ames 先生
a.p.
(#49)）

上海 - 1931年12月2日

关于克劳利的进一步情况

12月1日

上午11:00至中午12:00之间，克劳利、维德勒和司机前往各处处理老虎机事宜。

中午12:00至下午2:30 在家

下午2:30至3:30 维德勒乘坐克劳利的汽车去了某处。克劳利在凡尔登台（Verdun Terrace）漫无目的地走动。

下午3:30至5:30 克劳利和维德勒前往市区。无意中听到克劳利打电话给霍尔科姆少校，询问是否可以在下午4点至5点之间见面。

下午5:30 - 8:30 在家。维德勒也在。

克劳利夫人目前居住的房屋现在由克劳利雇佣的中国私人侦探监视。监视从本月1日午餐时间开始。

A. Li 的确切住址目前尚不清楚。Li 从公平路（Kung Ping Road）的办公室前往通商路778弄（Passage J. e. 778 Tongshang Road）。上述弄堂内约有100户人家，自然我们无法确定 Li 的住所。然而，Li 的下巴上有一颗痣，上面长着长毛，任何派往该弄堂的中国探员都能随时找到他。因此，我们已派遣一名助手前往 Li 的经营场所，指令其在周三中午12点前确定其确切居住地。

pages.en:
Shanghai - 1 - 12 - 31.

(#48)
Further re Crawley
November 30th

Crawley has been at home until 2 p. m.

At tiffin time Fidler visited Crawley's home accompanied by
Mr. Ribakoff, who is a notorious Russian smuggler and arms dealer.
Ribakoff is the same man, who was recently tried and fined by Chinese
Court for buying stolen pistols from members of the U. S. M. C. All
three i. e., Crawley, Fidler and Ribakoff had a tiffin together and had
a very business-like conversation, the nature of which is, of course,
unknown, but is is supposed that they plotted about "liquid flame" deal.

All three left by Crawley's car at 2 p. m., but Crawley and
Fidler returned home at 6 p. m.

According to information the trip to Harbin is postponed for
a week.
pages.zh:
上海 - 1931年12月1日。

(#48)
关于克劳利的进一步情况
11月30日

克劳利一直在家直到下午2点。

午餐时间，菲德勒（Fidler）陪同里巴科夫先生（Mr. Ribakoff）访问了克劳利的家，里巴科夫是一名臭名昭著的俄罗斯走私贩和军火商。里巴科夫就是最近因从美国海军陆战队成员手中购买被盗手枪而被中国法院审判并罚款的同一个人。克劳利、菲德勒和里巴科夫三人共进午餐，进行了非常商务化的谈话，其性质当然不为人知，但据推测他们策划了“液体火焰”交易。

三人于下午2点乘克劳利的汽车离开，但克劳利和菲德勒于下午6点回家。

据消息，哈尔滨之行推迟一周。

pages.en:
Mr. Aires
Cl. D
CONFIDENTIAL
Shanghai - 28 - 11 - 31
(#45)
Further re Crawley
Nov. 27th
10:30 a. m. - 12 noon Crawley out alone.
12 noon - 12:30 p. m. Crawley and chauffeur re slot-machines.
12:30 - 3:00 P. M. at home.
At 3:00 P. M. Crawley drove to the Chekiang Industrial Bank.
After being there half an hour he went to Szechuen - Nanking Roads corner,
where he picked up Widler and then proceeded to the corner of Sinza and
Ferry Roads to the place known as "Old Customs", where they met Mr. Tong,
whose car No. 7332 was outside. Remained inside for half an hour and
arrived home about 5:30 P. M.
------------------------------------------------------------
On the 27th instant Crawley claimed that within few days he
and Widler will go to Harbin for the purpose of demonstrating and selling
the Chinese Military a chemical used during the Great War by the Germans,
known as "Liquid Flame".
On his way to Harbin Crawley intends to stop in Tsingtau and take
his daughter to Tsingtau Convent.
Mrs. Crawley states that Crawley's children, who are very fond
of her and who visit her often, informed her that their father was preparing
to leave for Harbin, but that Widler is to stay in Shanghai and "Close her
mouth". Conversation of this nature is reported to have been overheard by
the children.
It is also reported that both Crawley and Widler have revolvers
pages.zh:
Aires 先生
Cl. D
机密
上海 - 1931年11月28日
(#45)
关于克劳利的进一步情况
11月27日
上午10:30 - 中午12:00 克劳利独自外出。
中午12:00 - 下午12:30 克劳利和司机处理老虎机事宜。
下午12:30 - 3:00 在家。
下午3:00 克劳利驾车前往浙江实业银行。
在那里停留半小时后，他前往四川路与南京路拐角处，在那里接上维德勒，然后前往新闸路与斐伦路拐角处一个被称为“老海关”的地方，在那里他们会见了童先生（Mr. Tong），其车牌号为7332的汽车停在外面。在里面停留了半小时，约于下午5:30到家。
------------------------------------------------------------
在本月27日，克劳利声称他和维德勒将在几天内前往哈尔滨，目的是向中国军方展示并出售一种在大战期间被德国人使用的化学品，称为“液体火焰”。
在前往哈尔滨的途中，克劳利打算在青岛停留，并将女儿送入青岛修道院。
克劳利夫人表示，克劳利的孩子们非常喜欢她并经常探望她，孩子们告诉她，他们的父亲正准备前往哈尔滨，但维德勒将留在上海并“让她闭嘴”。据称孩子们无意中听到了此类谈话。
另有报告称，克劳利和维德勒都持有左轮手枪

pages.en:
- 2 -
in their possession, but so far as is known they have no permit to carry
arms.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
在他们手中，但据所知，他们没有携带武器的许可证。

pages.en:
Mr. Aiers
O. S.
(#44)

Shanghai - 27 - 11 - 31

Further re Crawley

Nov. 26th

Crawley and his children left by car at 11 a. m. and returned
home at 3 p. m. They attended church service and then had tiffin somewhere.

Widler arrived at 4 p. m.

At 4:30 p. m. telephone call was received for Widler, the latter
answered and it was heard, that Widler named the caller by the name of Pan.
Widler also said something about "cargo", that Police is fixed and that he
and "Big Fellow" will come soon. During the conversation he several times
mentioned Yangtzepoo.

At 5 p. m. Crawley and Widler departed by former's car and returned
back at about 7 p. m.

------------------------------------------------------------

We visited Mrs. Crawley in the evening of November 26th and drank
up a bottle of "Vermouth". Mrs. Crawley stated as follows:-

1. She is giving information to S. M. P. and asked us to help her
and give her all possible information about Crawley's present activity.

2. She said that one of the senior members of C. I. D. is Crawley's
friend and is in his pay and that she must be very careful.

3. Regarding Crawley's correspondent in San Francisco, she said, that
Crawley did send his wires in different ciphers and always addressed
them either to Mr. Long, or to Mr. Fellow, or to Mr. Short. However,
lately he used to send wires only to Mr. Short and she thinks that all
three names belong to the same person.

------------------------------------------------------------
pages.zh:
Aiers 先生
O. S.
(#44)

上海 - 1931年11月27日

关于克劳利的进一步情况

11月26日

克劳利和他的孩子们于上午11点乘车离开，下午3点回家。他们参加了教堂礼拜，然后在某处吃了午餐。

维德勒于下午4点到达。

下午4:30 接到给维德勒的电话，后者接听，听到维德勒称来电者为潘（Pan）。维德勒还提到了一些关于“货物”的话，说警察方面已打点好，他和“大人物”（Big Fellow）很快就会来。在谈话中，他多次提到杨树浦（Yangtzepoo）。

下午5点 克劳利和维德勒乘前者的汽车离开，约于晚上7点返回。

------------------------------------------------------------

我们在11月26日晚上拜访了克劳利夫人，喝了一瓶“味美思”（Vermouth）。克劳利夫人陈述如下：-

1. 她正在向工部局警务处（S. M. P.）提供情报，并要求我们帮助她，向她提供有关克劳利当前活动的所有可能信息。

2. 她说刑事侦缉处（C. I. D.）的一名高级成员是克劳利的朋友，并受其收买，因此她必须非常小心。

3. 关于克劳利在旧金山的通讯员，她说，克劳利确实以不同的密码发送电报，并且总是发给朗先生（Mr. Long）、费洛先生（Mr. Fellow）或肖特先生（Mr. Short）。然而，最近他只给肖特先生发电报，她认为这三个名字属于同一个人。

------------------------------------------------------------

pages.en:
- 2 -

The date for sukiyaki party is settled for the coming week-end
and we will try to get more information from Mrs. Crawley.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

寿喜烧聚会（sukiyaki party）的日期已定在下周末，我们将尝试从克劳利夫人那里获取更多信息。

pages.en:
Mr Giers
Q.P.
Shanghai - 26 - 11 - 31
(#43)
Further re Crawley
Nov. 25th
11:00 A. M. 12:30 P. M. Crawley walked to some place on Bubbling
Well Road.
12:30 - 2:30 P. M. at home.
2:30 - 3:00 P. M. Crawley out in the car alone.
3 - 4 p. m. at home. During this period Widler arrived and
Crawley was visited by a young girl, who is supposed to be his new
secretary.
4 p. m. Crawley and Widler departed by the car.
6 p. m. Crawley returned by public ricksha alone.
7 p. m. Widler returned driving Crawley's car.
7:30 p. m. Crawley, Widler and former's children departed
somewhere to dine.
E. Widler's address is "Strand Hotel", Room No. 24.
As I reported we had an appointment with Mrs. Crawley yesterday
(25th) evening. However, did not find her at home, although we called at
her residence several times.
Will see her to-day, or to-morrow and get all particulars about
Crawley's partner in San Francisco.
pages.zh:
Giers 先生
Q.P.
上海 - 1931年11月26日
(#43)
关于克劳利的进一步情况
11月25日
上午11:00 - 下午12:30 克劳利步行至静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的某处。
下午12:30 - 2:30 在家。
下午2:30 - 3:00 克劳利独自驾车外出。
下午3 - 4点 在家。在此期间，维德勒到达，一名年轻女孩拜访了克劳利，据推测是他的新秘书。
下午4点 克劳利和维德勒驾车离开。
下午6点 克劳利独自乘坐公共人力车返回。
下午7点 维德勒驾驶克劳利的汽车返回。
下午7:30 克劳利、维德勒和前者的孩子们前往某处用餐。
E. 维德勒的地址是“斯特兰德饭店”（Strand Hotel），24号房间。
正如我报告的，我们昨天（25日）晚上与克劳利夫人有约。然而，虽然我们去她的住处几次，但未在家中找到她。
今天或明天将会见她，并获取有关克劳利在旧金山的合伙人的所有详细信息。

pages.en:
Mr. Aires
Cl. B.

COPY
Shanghai 25 - 11 - 31

(#42)
Further re Crawley
November 24th

At home until 11 a. m.
Between 11 and 12 a. m. walked around Verdun Terrace evidently
for the purpose of meeting Mrs. Crawley.
12 noon - 3 p. m. at home.
3 to 3:30 p. m. Crawley alone somewhere by motor car.
Returned home for 5 minutes asked if Widler had called and
left again returning at 5:30 p. m.
5:30 - 8 p. m. at home.
Widler appeared about 7 p. m. and remained for dinner.

We did not see Mrs. Crawley during past two days. Her living
place is closely watched by Crawley and Widler, but we spoke to her by
telephone and she promised to go with us to sukiyaki one of these days.
Today she asked us to visit her and bring her a bottle of "Vermouth".
pages.zh:
Aires 先生
Cl. B.

副本
上海 1931年11月25日

(#42)
关于克劳利的进一步情况
11月24日

在家直到上午11点。
上午11点至12点之间 在凡尔登台周围走动，显然是为了会见克劳利夫人。
中午12点 - 下午3点 在家。
下午3点至3:30 克劳利独自驾车前往某处。
回家5分钟，询问维德勒是否来过电话，随后再次离开，于下午5:30返回。
下午5:30 - 8点 在家。
维德勒约在晚上7点出现，并留下共进晚餐。

过去两天我们没有见到克劳利夫人。她的住处受到克劳利和维德勒的严密监视，但我们通过电话与她交谈，她答应这几天和我们一起去吃寿喜烧。今天她要求我们去拜访她，并给她带一瓶“味美思”。

pages.en:
The Class
C.1.D.
COPY
Shanghai - 24 - 11 - 31

(#41)
Further re Crawley
Nov. 23rd

Between 10 a. m. and 10:20 a. m. Crawley was out alone.
10:20 a. m. - 11 a. m. Crawley and chauffeur went to various
places re slot-machines. At 11 a. m. went to Chekiang Industrial Bank
and then to China Finance Corporation. Back home at 12 noon.
12 to 3 p. m. at home.
3 to 4 p. m. visited various places re slot-machines. At 4 p. m.
Crawley left car on Ningpo Road. Chauffeur visited some places in Hongkew
District and then returned for Crawley about 5:30 p. m. picking him up at
the corner of Jinkee and Yuen Ming Yuen Road.
At 5:30 p. m. Crawley and Mr. E. Fidler appeared outside of No. 25
Jinkee Road and drove to Sun Avenue, where Crawley and Fidler alighted and
dismissed the car. Opinion is given that they visited No. 14 Sun Avenue
occupied by Mr. Fan, a notorious Chinese arms dealer.
Crawley and Fidler returned to the former's house at about 7 p. m.
Just 5 minutes before their appearance a Chinese named Li, or Lee arrived and
said that he had an appointment with Crawley. This Chinese is an alleged
notorious smuggler, who has had "business" connections with Mr. "Colly" Kara.
The proper name and address of this Chinese may easily be traced as he drives
car No. 2632. Crawley, Fidler and Mr. Li had a conference which lasted for
about an hour.

Crawley has a certain business connection with a French Police
Inspector, who is in charge of Police Station, situated on Avenue Joffre,

上海 - 31年11月24日

(#41)
关于克劳利（Crawley）的进一步报告
11月23日

上午10时至10时20分，克劳利独自外出。
上午10时20分至11时，克劳利与司机前往多处地点，事关老虎机事宜。上午11时，前往浙江实业银行，随后前往中国建设银公司。中午12时返回家中。
下午12时至3时，在家。
下午3时至4时，走访多处地点，事关老虎机事宜。下午4时，克劳利将车留在宁波路。司机前往虹口区若干地点，随后于下午5时30分左右返回接克劳利，在静安寺路与圆明园路拐角处将其接上车。
下午5时30分，克劳利与E·菲德勒（E. Fidler）先生出现在静安寺路25号外，乘车前往孙科路（Sun Avenue），克劳利与菲德勒在此下车并遣散车辆。据研判，他们拜访了孙科路14号，该处由一名姓范的中国著名军火商居住。
克劳利与菲德勒于晚上7时左右返回前者家中。就在他们出现前5分钟，一名姓李（Li或Lee）的中国人抵达，称其与克劳利有约。这名中国人据称是一名臭名昭著的走私犯，曾与“科利”·卡拉（"Colly" Kara）先生有“业务”往来。此人的真实姓名和地址不难查考，因为他驾驶车牌号为2632的汽车。克劳利、菲德勒与李先生举行了一次会议，持续约一小时。
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
克劳利与一名法国巡捕房督察有一定的业务联系，该督察负责位于霞飞路、

pages.en:
just opposite Rue Sai Zung. It is believed that Crawley is giving infor-
mation about Chin as dealing in opium and thus is working against opium
syndicate in French Town and Mr. Tu Yu Sing, a member of French Municipal
Council. This is evidently a "smoke screen" behind which Crawley expects
to hide.

According to inside information Crawley andidler are evidently
up to their old tricks with arms. They are also plotting something against
Mrs. Crawley, as during the day and mostly in the evening either Crawley or
idler watched Mrs. Crawley's present residence.
pages.zh:
正对萨赛隆路（Rue Sai Zung）的警察局。据信，克劳利正在提供有关华人从事鸦片交易的情报，从而对抗法租界的鸦片辛迪加以及法国公董局董事杜月笙先生。这显然是一个“烟幕弹”，克劳利企图借此隐藏其真实目的。

根据内部消息，克劳利与菲德勒显然又在重操军火旧业。他们还在策划针对克劳利夫人的某种行动，因为在白天，尤其是傍晚，要么是克劳利，要么是菲德勒，一直在监视克劳利夫人目前的住所。

pages.en:
Shanghai - 23 - 11 - 31

(批：Aires
Mr C.Y.
(#40))

Further re Crawley

November 21st

Between 10:30 a m. and 12:30 p. m. on this date Crawley visited
various places re slot-machines.
12:30 to 3:50 p. m. at home.
3:50 to 6 p. m. Crawley and his foreign friend, who was mentioned
in two of my previous reports, went down town.
6 to 9 p. m. Crawley spent partly at home and partly walking around
Verdun Terrace and along Rue Bourgeat, evidently for the purpose of meeting
Mrs. Crawley "by accident".

November 22nd

11 a. m. to 12:30 p. m. to various places re slot-machines.
12:30 to 2:30 p. m. at home.
12:30 to 4 p. m. Crawley and foreigner, mentioned above, went down
town.
4 to 4:30 p. m. at home.
4:30 to 5:30 p. m. Crawley and foreigner went somewhere.
5:30 to 6 p. m. at home.

The name of Crawley's newly arrived friend is Mr. Ellie Widler. He
is a Swiss by nationality and is a notorious local smuggler, arms dealer and
swindler. Widler was away from Shanghai for some time after he and one Greek
swindled a Chinese official out of large sum of money. The Greek was con-
victed by the Chinese Court and is in Amoy Road Gaol at present, but Widler,
who is enjoying extraterritorial privileges and who was protected by Swiss
Consul, was not charged, but merely left Shanghai and spent his time and money
somewhere else, mostly in Tsingtau and Dairen.
pages.zh:
上海 - 31年11月23日

（批：艾尔斯 Aires
致 C.Y. 先生
(#40)）

关于克劳利的进一步报告

11月21日

当日上午10时30分至12时30分，克劳利走访了多处地点，事关老虎机事宜。
下午12时30分至3时50分，在家。
下午3时50分至6时，克劳利与其外国朋友（此人在我之前的两份报告中曾提及）前往市区。
下午6时至9时，克劳利部分时间在家，部分时间在凡尔登台（Verdun Terrace）及布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）沿线徘徊，显然是为了“偶然”遇见克劳利夫人。

11月22日

上午11时至12时30分，前往多处地点，事关老虎机事宜。
下午12时30分至2时30分，在家。
下午12时30分至4时，克劳利与上述外国人前往市区。
下午4时至4时30分，在家。
下午4时30分至5时30分，克劳利与该外国人前往某处。
下午5时30分至6时，在家。

克劳利新近到访的朋友名为埃利·维德勒（Ellie Widler）先生。他是瑞士籍，是当地臭名昭著的走私犯、军火商和骗子。维德勒在与一名希腊人诈骗了一名中国官员巨额款项后，曾离开上海一段时间。该希腊人被中国法院定罪，目前关押在爱文义路监狱，但享有治外法权特权并受瑞士领事保护的维德勒未被起诉，只是离开了上海，将时间和金钱耗费在其他地方，主要是在青岛和大连。

pages.en:
- 2 -

At present Widler is spending most of his time at Crawley's house
and has his meals with the former. On 22nd instant Crawley sent Widler to see
Mrs. Crawley to persuade her to come back, but she refused and told Widler
many bitter things about Crawley.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

目前，维德勒大部分时间在克劳利家中度过，并与前者一同用餐。本月22日，克劳利派维德勒去见克劳利夫人，劝她回来，但她拒绝了，并向维德勒诉说了许多关于克劳利的苦衷。

Mr. O.P.）
Shanghai - 21 - 11 - 31
(#39)
Further re Crawley
November 20th., 1931.
Crawley left for down town alone at 11 a. m. and returned about
noon together with the foreigner, who dined with him on the previous evening
and who is mentioned in report of 20th inst.
The above mentioned foreigner departed after tiffin but Crawley
stayed at home until 4 p. m. and then proceeded down town alone.
Returned about 7 p. m. together with above mentioned foreigner and
few minutes later they again left together.
Both back at 7:30 p. m.
Both left by car after dinner.
The description of the above mentioned foreigner is as follows:
short, rather stout, has small moustache. Dressed in old gray overcoat and
gray hat. Believed to be a Frenchman, as his English pronunciation is very
peculiar.
At first it was thought that this man was the long expected represen-
tative of Mills' Slot-Machine concern from U. S. A., but Crawley in answer
to questions replied in the negative but did not say who the visitor was.
However, it is evident that the visitor is a stranger in Shanghai as Crawley
is taking him around to show him something.
pages.zh:
（批：回复。
致 O.P. 先生）
上海 - 31年11月21日
(#39)
关于克劳利的进一步报告
1931年11月20日。
克劳利于上午11时独自前往市区，并于中午左右与前一晚与其共进晚餐的外国人一同返回，该外国人在本月20日的报告中已有提及。

上述外国人在午餐后离去，但克劳利留在家中直至下午4时，随后独自前往市区。
晚上7时左右，他与上述外国人一同返回，几分钟后两人再次一同离开。
两人于晚上7时30分返回。
晚餐后两人乘车离开。

上述外国人的体貌特征如下：身材矮小，相当粗壮，留有小胡子。身穿旧的灰色大衣，头戴灰色帽子。据信是法国人，因为其英语发音非常奇特。

起初认为此人是期待已久的美国米尔斯老虎机公司代表，但克劳利在被问及时予以否认，但未说明访客是谁。然而，显然该访客是上海的生面孔，因为克劳利正带他四处参观，向他展示某些事物。

pages.en:
Com. R. C. Oyens
(438) M. P.

Shanghai - 20 - 11 - 31.

Further re Crawley
Nov. 19th

Between 11 a. m. and 12 noon on this date Crawley spent in the
Passport Bureau of The Bureau of Public Safety in Nantao. On their way
back Crawley was studying two-three passport documents.

3 to 4 p. m. attending slot-machines on Ave. Joffre.
6 to 8:30 p. m. attending slot-machines on North Szechuen and
Broadway.

At 8:45 house telephone rang and a man's voice asked for Crawley.
The caller refused to give his name and insisted Crawley to be called to the
'phone. Crawley was summoned and invited the caller to dine with him. In
response to this invitation an unknown foreigner arrived by ricksha within
15-20 minutes and was warmly greeted by Crawley.

Efforts are being made to ascertain the name of the above mentioned
caller.

It is reported that Crawley is again talking about his proposed
departure from Shanghai. But states that he is afraid that Mrs. Crawley will
try to prevent his departure by committing suicide; that she will poison herself
or jump in the Whangpoo River.

The opinion is expressed that Crawley is going to murder his ex-wife
for the purpose of getting her out of the way and that he is now trying to
make it appear that she is about to commit suicide.

（批：This is
Considered
possible
M.R.N.）
pages.zh:
指挥官 R. C. 奥延斯（R. C. Oyens）
(438) M. P.

上海 - 31年11月20日。

关于克劳利的进一步报告
11月19日

当日11时至12时，克劳利在南市公安局护照科度过。返回途中，克劳利查阅了两三份护照文件。

下午3时至4时，在霞飞路查看老虎机。
下午6时至8时30分，在北四川路和百老汇路查看老虎机。

晚上8时45分，家中电话响起，一个男声要找克劳利。来电者拒绝透露姓名，坚持要求叫克劳利接听电话。克劳利被叫来接听，并邀请来电者共进晚餐。作为对这一邀请的回应，一名不明身份的外国人在15-20分钟内乘人力车抵达，受到克劳利的热情欢迎。

目前正在努力查明上述来电者的姓名。

据报道，克劳利再次谈及他计划离开上海。但他表示，他担心克劳利夫人会通过自杀来阻止他离开；她说她会服毒或跳入黄浦江。

有人提出看法，认为克劳利打算谋杀其前妻，以清除障碍，而他现在正试图制造她即将自杀的假象。

（批：此情况
被认为
有可能
M.R.N.）

关于克劳利的进一步报告
3月18日

        上午9:00 - 下午3:00  在家。
